articles.title: Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations
articles.content: Sensorized human demonstrations offer scalable data for mobile manipulation, but embodiment differences complicate policy learning. We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body policies from human data. We first introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which combines reconstructed scene geometry with demonstrated head and gripper trajectories to determine robot posture and generate collision-aware joint and base targets. Delay-calibrated action assignment converts these trajectories into actions. However, kinematic differences can leave residual pose errors, creating viewpoint mismatches between human demonstrations and robot observations. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses these errors during training to reduce reliance on mismatched views at deployment. Finally, because estimated actions cannot fully capture contact-rich interactions, we collect on-policy human corrections through DAgger to improve performance. We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five challenging tasks spanning articulated-object manipulation, deformable-object handling, constrained-space reaching, whole-body collision avoidance, and contact-rich bimanual coordination, achieving 87.0% average task progress. Video results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi

articles.title_zh: Pixel-UMI:从感知的人类演示中学习环境-智能全博迪操纵
articles.content_zh: 敏锐的人类演示为移动操纵提供了可扩展的数据,但表现差异使政策学习复杂化. 我们提出Pixel-UMI,这是一个从人类数据中学习环境意识全体政策的管道。 我们首先引入了Environment-Aware再瞄准(EAR),它结合了被重建的场景几何与被演示出的头部和握手轨迹,以确定机器人的姿势并产生出有碰撞意识的关节和基座目标. 延迟校正动作任务将这些轨迹转换为动作. 然而,动能差异可能留下剩余出错,从而造成人类演示和机器人观测之间的观点不匹配. 因此,我们引入了重新瞄准-错误-阿瓦雷·马斯金(REAM),在训练中利用这些错误减少部署时对不匹配观点的依赖. 最后,由于估计的行动不能完全抓住富于接触的互动,我们通过Dagger收集政策上的人类矫正以改善业绩。 我们评价了Pixel-UMI的五项挑战性任务,这些任务包括清晰的物体操纵、可变形物体处理、限制空间到达、全身避免碰撞以及接触丰富的双人协调,平均任务进度达到87.0%。 视频结果见https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi。

articles.title: Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation
articles.content: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system. We present Pixel, a co-designed full-stack system for learning general-purpose mobile manipulation. Pixel combines a low-cost wheeled humanoid with human-aligned kinematics and compliant grippers, multiple teleoperation and robot-free human data-collection interfaces, a unified whole-body controller, and a common policy learning pipeline across human and robot demonstrations. A hierarchical learning stack further enables language-conditioned visuomotor control and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the system across hardware, data collection, and policy learning, and demonstrate mobile-manipulation behaviors requiring dexterity, active perception, navigation, and whole-body coordination. We hope that Pixel provides an integrated and extensible foundation for studying how robot hardware, data, control, and learning can be designed together for robot learning. More results at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel

articles.title_zh: 像素:用于学习的全高阶机器人系统
articles.content_zh: 通用移动操控需要结合有能力的机器人硬件,可伸缩的演示集合,可表现的全身控制,以及有效的政策学习. 然而这些组件往往是独立开发的,造成不匹配,限制了整个系统的能力. 我们介绍Pixel,一个共同设计的用于学习通用移动操纵的全存储系统. 像素结合了一种低成本的轮式人造人与人相通的动能和相通的抓取器,多种远程操作和无机器人的人类数据收集接口,统一的全身控制器,以及跨越人和机器人演示的共同政策学习管道. 一个分级的学习堆进一步使语言条件化的粘接电动机控制和长距离任务执行成为可能. 我们通过硬件、数据收集和政策学习来评估系统,并展示移动操纵行为,这些行为需要分解、主动感知、导航和全身协调。 我们希望Pixel为研究机器人硬件,数据,控制和学习如何能一起设计为机器人学习提供一个综合而可扩展的基础. 更多结果见https://pixel-robot.com/pixel

articles.title: EgoActionBench: Benchmarking Dense Action Captioning for Egocentric Human Videos
articles.content: Learning from human data offers a scalable path toward embodied intelligence, yet it requires models to accurately understand fine-grained human actions from egocentric observations. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association. We introduce EgoActionBench, a benchmark that represents continuous human manipulation as temporally localized atomic actions associated with the left hand, right hand, or both hands. EgoActionBench contains 1,407 episodes with 41,132 human-refined action annotations. To evaluate such dense predictions, we propose an evaluation protocol that retrieves temporally eligible candidates, selects a prediction by content agreement, and scores semantic fidelity and temporal overlap alongside action precision and recall, jointly capturing what happens, when it happens, and which hand performs it. We benchmark 20 baseline models and systems on EgoActionBench and further adapt two backbones, Qwen3-VL-4B and LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B, through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning on automatically annotated training episodes. EgoAction improves EgoActionScore by 15.9 and 23.2 points on the two backbones, and both adapted models outperform all open-source baselines. Our experiments reveal substantial limitations of current models in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association, highlighting the gap between general video understanding and the action understanding required for embodied intelligence.

articles.title_zh: EgoAction Bench:为以EgoAction为核心的人类视频设定基准
articles.content_zh: 从人类数据中学习,提供了通向所体现智能的可伸缩路径,然而它需要模型从自我中心观察中准确理解精细的人类行为. 然而,在行动原子性、时间精确性和手动关系方面,现有基准仍然有限。 我们引入了EgoAction Bench这个基准,它代表了人类不断被操纵,作为时间上局部的原子行动,与左手,右手,或双手有关. "EgoAction Bench"收录了1,407集,并配有41,132个人改进后的行动说明. 为了评估如此密集的预测,我们提议一个评价协议,以检索暂时合格的候选人,通过内容协议选择一个预测,并将语义忠诚度和时间重叠与动作精度进行评分,并联合捕捉发生时发生的情况,以及哪个手执行。 我们在EgoAction Bench上以20个基准模型和系统为基准,并通过监督的微调,然后在自动附加说明的培训班上进行强化学习,进一步调整了两个主干,即Qune3-VL-4B和LLaVA-One Vision-2-8B。 电子行动改进了电子行动 两个骨干上得分15.9分和23.2分,两个被改造的模型都超过了所有开源基线. 我们的实验揭示了当前模型在动作原子性、时间精确度和手动关联方面的巨大局限性,突出了一般视频理解与所体现智能所需的动作理解之间的差距。

articles.title: Isekai3D SDG: A Platform for Diverse Synthetic Gameplay Visual Data
articles.content: We present Isekai3D Synthetic Data Generation (SDG), a platform for simulating and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay for research in vision and world models, neural graphics, gameplay agents, and other applications. The platform combines reusable environment and character assets with Unreal Engine plugins in a two-stage workflow. First, world simulation generates gameplay while recording the world state, character movements, actions, and camera tracks needed for replay. Second, the recorded simulation is replayed to capture selected outputs, such as rendered video, images, and depth maps, at a specified resolution and frame rate under selected rendering and camera configurations. Separating simulation from capture allows the same recorded gameplay to produce multiple output variants without repeating the original simulation. Visual outputs are accompanied by frame-aligned camera, character, and action metadata. The platform uploads generated data directly in a training-friendly format, reducing intermediate storage, preparation time, and manual processing. This report describes the design of our overall system, including the platform's assets, plugins, and their functionality, explaining how they work together to generate diverse synthetic gameplay data.

articles.title_zh: Isekai3D SDG:多元合成游戏视觉数据平台
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍 Isekai3D 合成数据生成(SDG),这是一个模拟并捕获合成3D游戏机的平台,用于视觉和世界模型,神经图形,游戏机代理等应用的研究. 该平台将可重复使用的环境和字符资产与不真实引擎插件在两阶段的工作流程中结合. 首先,世界模拟在记录重放所需的世界状态,人物运动,动作,相机轨迹的同时生成游戏玩法. 第二,重新播放所记录的模拟,以获取选定的产出,例如制作的视频、图像和深度图,在选定的渲染和相机配置下,以特定分辨率和帧率进行。 将模拟从捕捉中分离出来,可以让相同的被记录的游戏游戏产生多个输出变体而无需重复原作的模拟. 视觉输出伴有相框相机,字符和动作元数据. 平台上传直接以便于培训的格式生成了数据,减少了中间存储,准备时间和人工处理. 这份报告描述了我们整体系统的设计,包括平台的资产,插件,以及它们的功能,解释了它们如何合作生成多样化的合成游戏游戏数据.

articles.title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate detailed video captions, yet they may overemphasize minor details while overlooking essential context and key events. We argue that not all visual evidence deserves equal attention, as the importance of visual information depends on the content of each video. Motivated by this observation, we propose Reviso, an agentic video captioning framework that learns what to observe and how to gather relevant visual evidence. From a low-frame-rate global preview, Reviso constructs a hierarchical Context--Focus--Points (CFP) observation plan that identifies the video context, prioritizes key aspects, and defines concrete observation targets and corresponding tools. Guided by this plan, Reviso performs goal-directed active perception by selectively revisiting temporal segments and combining tools for fine-grained inspection. It interprets the acquired evidence, updates its plan as needed, and integrates global and local information to generate the final caption. To learn this observation strategy, we develop a verification-guided pipeline that constructs high-quality training trajectories through factual verification and teacher-guided refinement. We further train Reviso using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), incorporating a key-fact reward for caption quality, a Plan Alignment Reward (PAR) for identifying important observation targets, and an Unproductive Tool-Call Penalty (UTCP) that adjusts observation-cost penalties based on caption quality. Experiments across four video captioning benchmarks show that Reviso outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines, while its generated captions better support downstream video question answering. These findings highlight the effectiveness and potential of priority-guided active observation for video captioning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Reviso:并非所有视觉证据都使视频字幕中的注意力相等
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)可以生成详细的视频字幕,但它们可能会过分强调小细节,而忽略重要上下文和关键事件. 我们主张,并非所有的视觉证据都值得同等重视,因为视觉信息的重要性取决于每个视频的内容. 基于这一观察,我们提议Reviso, 一个代理视频字幕框架, 学习观察的内容以及如何收集相关的视觉证据。 从低帧率的全球预览中,Reviso构建了分级的上下文-焦点-点(CFP)观测计划,该计划能识别视频背景,确定关键方面的优先次序,并定义具体的观测目标和相应的工具. 在该计划的指导下,Reviso通过有选择地重新审视时间段并结合各种工具进行精细检查,实现目标导向活性感知. 它解释获得的证据,根据需要更新计划,并整合全球和地方信息,生成最终标题。 为了了解这一观察战略,我们开发了一个核查指导管道,通过事实核查和教师指导的改进,构建出高质量的培训轨迹。 我们进一步利用集团相对政策优化(GPRO)来培训Reviso,其中包含对标题质量的关键事实奖励、用于确定重要观测目标的计划对接奖励(PAR)以及基于标题质量调整观察成本处罚的无效果工具呼叫处罚(UTCP)。 跨越四个视频字幕基准的实验显示,Reviso比评估的开源基线要好,而其生成的字幕更能支持下游视频问答. 这些调查结果突出了以优先指导方式积极观察视频字幕的有效性和潜力。

articles.title: Structured Visual Landscape: Generating Preferred Representations in Biological and Artificial Neural Networks
articles.content: Understanding how neurons respond to visual stimulus is an important question in both deep learning and neuroscience. It has significant implications for enhancing the interpretability of black-box artificial neural networks and for understanding the visual representation in the human brain. We propose a structured visual representations landscape and design an activation-based prior that allows us to effectively regularize the landscape with activations from brain regions or neural network units. Our model Vis-Lens integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model into an image generation framework. It enables the generation of natural, realistic preferred images by directly modifying the activation-regularized latent codes without per-image iterative optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on both artificial neural networks and human visual cortex using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. Our framework improves activation modulation and image realism compared with a recent state-of-the-art method for generating preferred visual representations of these neural targets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 结构视觉景观:在生物和人工神经网络中产生偏好的代表
articles.content_zh: 理解神经元如何响应视觉刺激,是深入学习和神经科学中的一个重要问题. 它对于增强黑盒人工神经网络的可解释性,以及对于理解人脑中的视觉表现具有重大影响. 我们提出一个结构化的视觉表现图,并设计一个基于激活的先行,使我们能够通过脑区域或神经网络单元的活化来有效地规范地貌. 我们的Vis-Lens模型将可变自编码器和扩散模型整合到图像生成框架. 它通过直接修改激活-正态化潜伏代码而无需进行成像迭代优化,从而能够生成自然的,现实的首选图像. 我们利用功能磁共振成像(fMRI)数据,在人工神经网络和人类视觉皮层上展示我们的框架的有效性. 我们的框架改进了激活调制和图像现实主义,比起最近一种最先进的方法来产生这些神经目标的优先视觉表现.

articles.title: 3D-BBDA: Backpropagation-Free Black-Box Domain Adaptation for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition
articles.content: Robust 3D point-cloud recognition is critical for robotics, mapping, and urban sensing, yet point-cloud classifiers often suffer performance drops under domain shifts caused by sensor changes, environmental variation, and acquisition artifacts. Many existing adaptation methods are difficult to deploy in practice because they require access to source data or the internal parameters of the source model, which may be restricted by privacy, licensing, or security constraints. We present 3D-BBDA, a backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation framework that adapts a source-trained predictor to unlabeled target data using only black-box outputs. Our method performs pseudo-label guided prototype-based alignment and employs a weighted prediction module to fuse source logits with alignment logits, reducing sensitivity to noisy pseudo-labels. To stabilize prototype memory when pseudo-label coverage is incomplete, we construct a Gaussian-perturbed prototype prior from unlabeled target predictions and use it as a fallback for missing or unreliable class prototypes during alignment. Experiments on four corrupted 3D benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines. On ModelNet-40C, 3D-BBDA achieves mean errors of 32.08% (PointNet) and 29.62% (GDANet), outperforming Source-only (35.88% / 34.03%) and BFTT3D (33.78% / 32.36%). 3D-BBDA requires only a single forward pass with no gradient updates making it suitable for real-time, privacy-preserving deployment in transferable 3D recognition pipelines. Project page is available at https://visdomlab.github.io/3D_BBDA

articles.title_zh: 3D-BBDA:为强力3D点云识别而进行反传播-无黑-牛域适应
articles.content_zh: 强力3D点-云识别对机器人,绘图,和城市感知至关重要,然而点-云分级器往往会因传感器变化,环境变异,以及获取文物等导致域位转移而出现性能下降. 许多现有的适应方法在实践中难以应用,因为它们要求获得源数据或源模型的内部参数,而源数据或参数可能受到隐私、许可或安全限制的限制。 我们提出3D-BBDA,这是一种无反传播的黑盒域适应框架,它只使用黑盒输出来使一个源训练的预测器适应无标签的目标数据. 我们的方法进行伪标签制导原型对接,并使用一个加权预测模块来将源日志与配对日志连接起来,降低了对响亮的伪标签的敏感性. 为了在伪标签覆盖不完整时稳定原型内存,我们先从无标签的目标预测中构建出高斯-扰动原型,并在对齐时用作缺失或不可靠的类原型的倒置. 对被腐蚀的4个三维基准的实验表明,比起强基线,情况持续改善。 在ModelNet-40C上,3D-BBDA的平均误差为32.08%(PointNet)和29.62%(GDANet),优于纯源(35.88%/34.03%)和BFTT3D(33.78%/32.36%)。 3D-BBDA只需要一个单一的前进通路,没有梯度更新,使其适合在可转移的3D识别管中进行实时,隐私保留部署. 项目网页见https://visdomlab.github.io/3D_BBDA。

articles.title: PlantVLM-Edge: Quantized Vision-Language Models for On-Device Crop Health Diagnosis
articles.content: Timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is essential for sustainable agricultural production, yet accurate diagnosis often requires expert knowledge that is not readily available. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and natural-language interaction, creating new opportunities for intelligent crop health assessment. However, deploying VLMs on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper presents PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that can run entirely on resource-constrained edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge combines agricultural domain adaptation, post-training quantization, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. The framework is backbone-agnostic: we validate it with two different VLM types with varying scale and architecture (Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B), four quantization schemes, and two diagnostic domains (plant diseases and insect pests), and we deploy all variants on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Eight-bit quantization affects answer quality minimally relative to the full-precision model, and 4-bit activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality on both domains while reducing the weight memory of the 2B backbone by 49%. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weight memory, returns its first token in about 0.12 s, and completes a 64-token diagnostic response in 0.78 s. These results demonstrate that timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is practical on edge devices, providing a foundation for next-generation crop monitoring and decision support systems.

articles.title_zh: PlantVLM-Edge:关于作物健康诊断的量化展望-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 及时和准确的作物健康诊断对可持续农业生产至关重要,但准确的诊断往往需要不易获得的专家知识。 最近的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在视觉理解,推理和自然-语言交互方面表现出了卓越的能力,为智能作物健康评估创造了新的机会. 然而,在受资源限制的设备上部署甚高频仍然具有挑战性,因为它们需要大量的计算和内存。 本文介绍了PlantVLM-Edge,这是一个用于对话作物健康诊断的量化视觉语言框架,可以完全运行在受资源制约的边缘设备上. PlantVLM-Edge结合了农业领域适应,培训后量化,以及提供离线聊天界面的在线设备,允许种植者提出开放式问题并接受诊断,症状解释,管理指导而无需云连接. 该框架具有骨干不可知性:我们用两种不同VLM类型进行验证,其规模和结构各有不同(Qune3-VL-2B和LLaVA-1.5-7B),四个量化计划,以及两个诊断领域(植物疾病和昆虫),我们在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上部署所有变种. 八位分数相对于全精度模型影响答题质量最小,而4位活化-知重分数(AWQ)在两个域上保留了全精度分数答题质量的98.6%,同时将2B主干线的分数内存减少了49%. 在最紧凑的形式中,PlantVLM-Edge需要2.01 GiB的重量内存,在约0.12 s中还原出第一个活符,并在0.78 s中完成64个活符的诊断反应. 这些结果表明,在边缘装置上及时和准确的作物健康诊断是可行的,为下一代作物监测和决策支持系统奠定了基础。

articles.title: CoLa3D: Composable Latent 3D Decomposition
articles.content: We introduce CoLa3D, a simple and effective model for composable 3D scene decomposition that, given a single whole-scene latent from either a single image or an existing scene mesh as input, directly outputs a set of object meshes with consistent spatial layout that can be assembled back into a coherent scene. CoLa3D introduces a novel paradigm for 3D scene decomposition within a shared whole-scene latent, unlike alternatives that perform per-object generation in canonical spaces and then glue the objects back together with fragile pose and scale estimation. The network is a lightweight, flexible, and scalable query-based transformer that accepts various types of queries, including 2D masks, 3D points, and learnable queries, and learns to decompose the scene into objects in a compact latent space. On both synthetic and real-world datasets, CoLa3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on composable 3D scene decomposition, substantially improving global scene-level consistency and object-level quality while running 2 times faster and using less than 1% of SAM 3D's training data. Visible depth on par with MoGe2 further confirms that latent decomposition preserves accurate visible scene geometry while producing physically complete, decomposable object meshes.

articles.title_zh: CoLA3D:可编译的Latent 三维分解
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了 CoLa3D, 一种简单有效的可相容的 三维场景分解模型, 通过单个图像或现有场景网的单个整体场景潜伏作为输入, 直接输出一组具有相容空间布局的物体间歇, 可以重新组装成一个相容的场景 。 CoLa3D引入了在共享的全场潜在范围内进行3D场景分解的新范式,与在犬形空间中进行每个对象生成,然后用脆弱的姿势和尺度估计将物体粘接回一起的替代品不同. 网络是一个轻而易举,灵活而可伸缩的基于查询的变压器,它接受各种类型的查询,包括2D口罩,3D分,以及可学习的查询,并学会将场景分解为紧凑的潜在空间中的物体. 在合成和现实世界数据集上,CoLa3D在可相容的3D场景分解上实现了最先进的性能,大大提高了全局场景水平的一致性和对象级别质量,同时运行速度快了2倍并使用了不到1%的SAM 3D的训练数据. 与MoGe2对等的可见深度进一步证实,潜在分解在产生物理上完整可分解的物体间隙的同时,保留了准确可见的场景几何.

articles.title: Contrastive Adapter Training and Consensus Knowledge Distillation for Multi-Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Skin Cancer Diagnosis
articles.content: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) have shown promising performance, their effectiveness often deteriorates on data from heterogeneous clinical sources. Conventional domain adaptation methods address domain shift but require access to source data during adaptation, which is often infeasible due to privacy regulations. Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses this limitation by leveraging multiple labeled source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data. However, existing MSFDA methods rely on full backbone fine-tuning, leading to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting on small clinical datasets, and address domain shift at the aggregation stage without establishing a shared domain-invariant feature space. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels or confidence-weighted aggregation introduces noisy supervision signals under domain shift. To address these limitations, we propose CAT-CKD, consisting of two components: (1) contrastive adapter training (CAT), which trains lightweight ConvPass adapters within a frozen ViT backbone using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific model training, and (2) consensus knowledge distillation (CKD), which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using KL divergence. Experiments on five publicly available skin lesion datasets show that CAT-CKD achieves an average AUROC of 86.1%, outperforming existing MSFDA methods while requiring only 4.3M trainable parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.

articles.title_zh: 皮肤癌诊断中多源无域适应的矛盾适应器培训和共识知识扭曲
articles.content_zh: 皮肤癌的诊断,特别是将黑色素瘤与良性nevi区分开来,具有挑战性,因为损伤之间的视觉相似性. 虽然进化神经网络(CNNs)和视觉变换器(ViTs)表现出有希望的性能,但其有效性在来自不同临床来源的数据上往往会恶化. 常规域适应方法处理域位转移,但要求在适应过程中获取源数据,由于隐私规定,这些数据往往不可行. 多源无监督域适应(MSFDA)通过利用多个被贴上标签的源域一般化到一个未贴上标签的目标域而解决了这一限制,而不需要访问源数据. 然而,现有的MSFDA方法依赖于完全的主干线微调,导致灾难性地遗忘并过度适应小型临床数据集,并在集合阶段解决域位转移而未建立共享域位-变量特征空间. 此外,它们对硬伪标签或信心加权汇总的依赖,在域转移下引入了吵闹的监督信号. 为解决这些局限性,我们提议CAT-CKD,由两个部分组成:(1) 对比性适配器训练(CAT),在被冻结的ViT主干内使用有监督的对比性学习(SCL)对轻量级ConvPass适配器进行培训,以便在针对特定来源的模型培训之前建立共享域-不变量特征空间;(2) 共识知识分馏(CKD),将来自多源模型的对数汇总成共识监督信号,并使用KL分数对未贴标签的目标数据进行校正。 对5个可公开获得的皮肤损伤数据集的实验表明,CAT-CKD平均实现86.1%的AUROC,优于现有的MSFDA方法,而只需要4.3M可训练参数. 该代码可见于https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.

articles.title: HIVE-Diff: High Frame Rate HDR Video Reconstruction from a Single LDR Frame and Events
articles.content: High frame rate HDR video is important in applications such as autonomous driving and scientific imaging, where rapid motion and extreme illumination often occur simultaneously. Conventional frame cameras face a trade-off between temporal resolution and dynamic range, while event cameras provide complementary high-speed brightness-change measurements over a wide illumination range. These properties have motivated event-based HDR reconstruction, with existing methods broadly following event-only and hybrid event-frame paradigms. Event-only HDR reconstruction, however, suffers from brightness and color drift due to the lack of absolute intensity references. Hybrid event-frame methods alleviate this ambiguity using low-dynamic-range (LDR) frames as anchors, but most perform one-to-one HDR reconstruction at available LDR timestamps. In this work, we investigate single-reference HDR temporal expansion, reconstructing N HDR frames from one LDR reference and events instead of N aligned LDR observations. We develop HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that decomposes the task into event-guided temporal generation and HDR content completion. Because paired real HDR-event data are scarce, we train on synthetic data and adapt the model to real event domains using LDR-event sequences as proxy supervision with teacher-student distillation. Experiments on synthetic and multiple real-world datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction quality and robust real-data adaptation.

articles.title_zh: HIVE - Diff:高框架率人类发展报告 从单个 LDR 框架和事件进行视频重建
articles.content_zh: 高帧率的HDR视频在自主驱动和科学成像等应用中很重要,在这些应用中,快速运动和极端发光经常同时发生. 常规框架相机面临时间分辨率和动态范围之间的取舍,而事件相机则在宽光度范围内提供互补的高速亮度变化测量. 这些特性推动了以事件为基础的人类发展报告的重建,现有方法基本上遵循只事件和混合事件框架范式。 然而,由于缺乏绝对的强度参考,仅针对事件的《人类发展报告》重建受到亮度和色彩漂移的影响。 混合事件框架方法以低动态距离(LDR)框架为锚地来缓解这种模糊性,但大多数方法在可用的LDR时间戳下进行一对一的HDR重建. 在这项工作中,我们调查单一参考的《人类发展报告》时间扩展情况,从一个LDD参考和事件重建国家HDR框架,而不是从N一致的LDR观测结果中重建。 我们开发了HIVE-Diff,这是一个以事件为条件的视频传播框架,将任务分解为由事件指导的时间生成和HDR内容完成. 由于配对的HDR-事件数据稀缺,我们进行合成数据培训,并用LDR-事件序列作为代理监督,对模型进行调整,使之适应真实事件域,并配以师生蒸馏. 对合成和多种现实世界数据集的实验表明,重建质量良好,实际数据适应性强。

articles.title: Bg-Mix: On Using Image Backgrounds for Data Augmentation in Electron Microscopy Images
articles.content: Electron microscopy (EM) serves as a cornerstone in virology enabling the visualization of viral particles and is widely used in research, diagnostics and morphological characterization of pathogens. Computer-assisted image analysis can help facilitate and speed up this labor-intensive method, however, typical EM virus datasets are small and sparsely labeled, resulting in a lack of readily available deep learning models due to training limitations. To overcome data shortages and leverage content-rich, diverse sample backgrounds, we employed background-based data augmentation. To this end, we propose Bg-Mix, a form of data augmentation method, which decomposes training images into foreground objects and backgrounds and subsequently rearranges both into novel augmented images. This not only enhances the performance of object detection models but also increases the diversity of the training data. Using Bg-Mix provides an increase between +0.8 and +3.3 box mean average precision (mAP) points over the baseline when tested across two datasets using two architectures, thereby demonstrating its effectiveness.

articles.title_zh: Bg-Mix:在电子显微镜图像中利用图像背景数据增强
articles.content_zh: 电子显微镜(EM)是病毒学的一个基石,能够使病毒颗粒可视化,并被广泛用于病原体的研究,诊断和形态特征鉴定. 计算机辅助的图像分析可以帮助促进并加速这种劳动密集型的方法,然而,典型的EM病毒数据集很少,而且标签很少,因此由于培训限制,缺乏现成的深层学习模型. 为了克服数据短缺,利用内容丰富、样本背景多样的情况,我们采用了基于背景的数据扩充。 为此,我们提出Bg-Mix,一种数据增强方法,将训练图像分解为前景对象和背景,并随后将两者重新排列为新颖的增强图像. 这不仅会提高物体检测模型的性能,而且会增加训练数据的多样性. 使用 Bg-Mix 可以在使用两个架构在两个数据集中测试时,在+0.8和+3.3框平均值精度(mAP)点比基线多出一分,从而显示其有效性.

articles.title: Intent2CAD: How Semantic-Parametric Supervision Shapes Text-to-CAD Generation
articles.content: Text-to-CAD generation aims to make CAD modeling more accessible by generating executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, practical CAD workflows require more than executable geometry: generated programs should also expose reusable structure that supports later modification. We introduce intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation, where design intent is expressed as recoverable code-level signals: semantic features, reusable parameters, and lightweight parametric relations. Rather than changing the model architecture or decoding procedure, we investigate how supervision representation granularity affects both CAD generation and zero-shot intent-preserving editing. To enable this study, we construct IntentCAD-100K, a 100K paired text--code dataset built by converting low-level CAD construction traces into executable CadQuery programs. We further construct IntentCAD-Edit-1K to evaluate zero-shot intent-preserving editing from the same representation perspective. Intent2CAD uses a two-stage conservative lifting pipeline: semantic lifting rewrites reliable primitive groups into feature-level operations, while parametric lifting exposes lightweight parametric relations. Under controlled fine-tuning, semantic lifting mainly improves generation reliability and feature recovery, reducing IR from 2.39% to 0.22% and achieving 99.96% API Recovery, while parametric lifting makes reusable relation structure explicit and further improves relation-aware zero-shot editing. Datasets and code are available at https://github.com/JinboYang94/Intent2CAD.

articles.title_zh: 意向2CAD:语义-参数法 监控形状文本对 CAD 生成
articles.content_zh: 文本到CAD生成旨在通过从自然语言描述生成可执行的CAD程序来使CAD模型更容易被取用. 然而,实用的CAD工作流程需要的不仅仅是可执行几何:生成的程序还应该暴露支持后期修改的可再用结构. 我们引入了面向意图的文本到CAD生成,其中设计意图表示为可被恢复的代码级信号:语义特征,可再用参数,和轻量级参数关系. 而不是改变模型架构或解码程序,我们调查监督代表颗粒性如何影响CAD生成和零镜头意图保留编辑. 为了能够进行这一研究,我们构建了IntentCAD-100K,一个由将低等CAD构造痕迹转换为可执行的CadQuery程序所构建的100K对文本编码数据集. 我们进一步构建了IntentCAD-Edit-1K,以从同样的代表角度评价零镜头意图保留编辑. Intent2CAD使用两相保守式起重管:语义起重将可靠的原始组重写为地物级操作,而参数起重则暴露出轻量级参数关系. 在有控制的微调下,语义提升主要能提高生成可靠性和特性恢复,使IR从2.39%降至0.22%并实现 99.96%的API. 恢复,而参数提升则使可再用的关系结构明确,并进一步改善了关系意识零发编辑. 数据集和代码见https://github.com/Jinbo Yang94/Intent2CAD.

articles.title: Align Once to Explain: Feature Alignment for Scalable B-cosification of Foundational Vision Transformers
articles.content: Foundational vision models have become the de facto standard for many vision tasks due to their strong performance. However, they are notoriously opaque and remain hard to interpret. We present ALOE (ALign Once to Explain), a one-time, label-free feature alignment approach that efficiently converts foundational vision models into inherently interpretable B-cos variants. Once aligned, the B-cos backbone is used as a drop-in replacement across several downstream tasks-amortizing the cost of interpretability. ALOE is robust across pre-training paradigms (supervised, self-supervised, vision-language) and can preserve teacher-level generalization with orders of magnitude less data than training from scratch. On classification, it strongly outperforms vanilla B-cosification (e.g., +10.5 p.p. top-1 on ImageNet for DINOv3 ViT-B/16), retains strong linear probing, k-NN, and zero-shot transfer competitive with foundational backbones (DINOv3, SigLIP2) across diverse downstream datasets. It also preserves spatially structured features useful for dense prediction, while yielding well-localized and highly human-interpretable explanations by design.

articles.title_zh: 对齐一次性解释:可缩放 B 的特性对齐基础视野变形器
articles.content_zh: 基础性愿景模型由于性能强而成为许多愿景任务的实际标准. 然而,它们臭名昭著地不透明,而且仍然难以解释。 我们提出ALOE(ALign Once to Explain),是一种一次性的,无标签的特征对接方法,它有效地将基础视觉模型转换为内在可解释的B-cos变体. 一旦对齐,B-COs主干线就被用作跨下游几个任务的倒置替代,以抵消可解释性的成本。 ALOE在培训前的范式(监督,自我监督,视觉语言)中都很强势,可以保留师生一级的通俗化,数量级数据从头到尾都不如培训. 在分类上,它强于香草B-编码(例如:为DINOv3 VIT-B/16在ImageNet上为+10.5p.top-1),保留了强线性检测,k-NN,并保持了与基础骨干(DINOv3,SigLIP2)的零发相竞争,跨越了不同的下游数据集. 它还保留了对密集预测有用的空间结构特征,同时通过设计得出了位置化和高度人性化的解释.

articles.title: Evaluating Depth-Augmented Visual Features for Cross-Dataset Lunar Traversability Estimation
articles.content: Autonomous mobility is essential for sustained lunar surface operations, as communication delays and line-of-sight occlusions limit continuous teleoperation. Although recent traversability estimation methods increasingly rely on deep learning, the domain gap between terrestrial analogue environments and real lunar terrain can limit their generalisation, and real lunar traversability labels are scarce, making fully supervised training difficult. To address these challenges, we build a weakly supervised framework trained on sparse pairwise annotations and study whether augmenting visual features with depth-derived geometric information: depth, surface normals, and combined geometric descriptors. We evaluate the models in both in-domain and cross-domain settings using two terrestrial analogue datasets and the real lunar Chang'E PCAM dataset. Contrary to expectations, we find that naive geometric augmentation yields no consistent improvement over a strong visual-only baseline in either setting, with effects small relative to seed-to-seed variance. Instead, the choice of training source emerges as the dominant factor in transfer quality: models trained on domain-relevant sources transfer substantially better to real lunar imagery than the geometric fusion strategy improves any single model. Our evaluation runs onboard a resource-constrained edge device and provides a controlled baseline for designing more expressive multimodal fusion architectures in future lunar perception systems.

articles.title_zh: 评估跨数据集月球移动性估计的深度增强视觉特征
articles.content_zh: 自主移动对于持续的月球地表操作至关重要,因为通信延迟和视线堵塞限制了连续的远程操作. 虽然最近的可转性估计方法越来越依赖深度学习,但陆地模拟环境与真实月球地形之间的域位差距可以限制其通缩,而真实的月球可转性标签也很少,使得完全监督的培训变得困难. 为了应付这些挑战,我们建立了一个受到薄弱监督的框架,经过培训后,只有稀少的对称说明,并研究是否增加了带有深度几何信息的视觉特征:深度、地表常态和综合几何描述符。 我们利用两个地面模拟数据集和真正的月球常平ECAM数据集,对域内和跨域设置中的模型进行评估. 与预期相反,我们发现,天真几何增生在两种情况下都无法比强的仅可视基线得到持续改善,其影响相对于种子到种子的差异较小。 相反,选择培训来源是转让质量的主导因素:接受过域相关来源培训的模型比几何聚变战略改进任何单一模型要好得多地转移到真实的月球图像上。 我们的评价运行在资源受限制的边缘装置上,为未来月球感知系统中设计更能表达式的多模式聚变架构提供了可控基线.

articles.title: Circumventing Magnitude Collapse via Modular Two-Stage Open-Set Recognition
articles.content: Open-set recognition (OSR) requires neural networks to classify known classes while rejecting unknown samples, which is critical for real-world deployment. So far, OSR research studied and developed representation learning and postprocessing methods independently and their interactions remain unexplored. In this paper, we reconsider OSR as a modular two-stage pipeline and present the first systematic study of interactions between representation learning and postprocessing methods across dataset scales and usage of known unknown data. First, we discover a failure mode we term \emph{magnitude collapse}, where representation learning methods that utilize known unknown data can suffer performance degradation at large scale and irreversibly destroy discriminative information, despite excelling at small scale. Second, we study the modular interactions and reveal when they can be leveraged for modular performance gains via two-stage processing and where interaction effects amplify performance degradation due to magnitude collapse. Third, we show how these findings can be used to achieve state-of-the-art performance with a simple $K+1$ class classifier baseline and magnitude-aware postprocessing while circumventing magnitude collapse. Finally, our results demonstrate that small-scale evaluations with known unknown data are not predictive of large-scale performance, invalidating current best practices in OSR research. Code available at https://github.com/TwoDigitsOneNumber/Two-Stage-OSR.

articles.title_zh: 通过模块化的双层开放组合识别循环放大折叠
articles.content_zh: Open-set识别(OSR)要求神经网络在拒绝未知样本的同时对已知类别进行分类,这对于现实世界的部署至关重要. 迄今为止,业务标准研究独立地研究和开发了代表学习和后处理方法,其相互作用仍未被探讨。 在本文中,我们重新考虑将业务标准作为模块化的两阶段程序,并介绍关于代表学习和后处理方法在数据集尺度上的相互作用以及已知未知数据的使用的第一次系统研究。 首先,我们发现了一种失败模式,我们称之为\emph{magnitude ball},在这个模式中,利用已知未知数据的代表性学习方法可能会发生大规模性能退化并不可逆转地破坏歧视性信息,尽管在小规模上表现优异。 第二,我们研究模块互动,并揭示何时可以通过两阶段处理为模块化性能收益利用这些互动,以及互动效应因规模倒塌而加剧性能退化。 第三,我们说明如何利用这些结论,在避免规模倒塌的同时,通过简单的$K+1美元类分级基线和体积认识后处理,实现最新性能。 最后,我们的结果表明,有已知未知数据的小规模评价不能预测大规模业绩,从而否定了目前业务社会责任研究的最佳做法。 在https://github.com/TwoDigits One Number/Two-Stage-OSR上可以找到代码.

articles.title: VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing
articles.content: Video dubbing aims to synthesize lip movements that match target speech while preserving the speaker identity, head pose, and background of a source video. Existing editors are predominantly trained via self-reconstruction under original paired audio, even though the source mouth becomes a conflicting target when driving speech is replaced. We introduce replacement-aware cross-audio supervision: paired-audio samples use full-frame reconstruction, whereas unpaired replacement-audio samples mask out source-mouth reconstruction losses and supervise the mouth solely through audio-visual synchronization while preserving unmasked facial regions and background. Because offline dubbing provides the complete source video and target speech beforehand, we present VidDub, a full-context diffusion editor distilled into two denoising steps (2 NFE). Our replacement-aware teacher first learns accurate lip synchronization without regressing toward conflicting source mouth movements. Matched trajectory regression then transfers the teacher's CFG-guided trajectories to a two-step student, and distribution matching distillation recovers visual quality after step compression. We will release the curated training dataset, VidDub-Bench, fixed paired- and cross-audio evaluation manifests, preprocessing outputs, and unified evaluation code. Across three training seeds, masking out conflicting source-mouth reconstruction improves cross-audio Sync-C by 0.833; the final two-step model combines strong lip synchronization with superior visual quality, identity preservation, and visual speech recognition across four benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: VidDub: 双步视频 Dubing 的替换- 软件分级
articles.content_zh: 视频配音旨在合成与目标演讲相匹配的口语动作, 现有的编辑人员主要通过在原配对音频下进行自建来进行训练,尽管在驾驶语音被替换时源口成为相冲突的目标. 我们引入了重置意识跨音频监督:配对-音频样本采用全帧重建,而未配对的重置-音频样本掩盖了源口重建损失,仅通过视听同步来监督口腔,同时保留了未蒙面的面部区域和背景. 因为离线配音提前提供了完整的源视频和目标演讲,所以我们呈现出VidDub,一个完整的通则传播编辑器蒸馏出两个去诺化步骤(2个NFE). 我们的替代意识老师首先学会准确的口语同步,而不向相冲突的源口运动倒退. 相匹配的轨迹回归后再将老师的CFG制导轨迹转移给双步生,分布相匹配的蒸馏在相继压缩后会恢复视觉质量. 我们将公布经整理的培训数据集VidDub-Bench、固定对接和跨音频评价清单、预处理产出和统一评价代码。 在三个培训种子中,掩盖相互冲突的源口重建使跨声道Sync-C改进了0.833;最后的两步模式结合了强口同步与优异视觉质量,身份保存,视觉语音识别四个基准.

articles.title: Image Guided Depth Upsampling using Anisotropic Total Generalized Variation
articles.content: In this work we present a novel method for the challenging problem of depth image upsampling. Modern depth cameras such as Kinect or Time of Flight cameras deliver dense, high quality depth measurements but are limited in their lateral resolution. To overcome this limitation we formulate a convex optimization problem using higher order regularization for depth image upsampling. In this optimization an anisotropic diffusion tensor, calculated from a high resolution intensity image, is used to guide the upsampling. We derive a numerical algorithm based on a primaldual formulation that is efficiently parallelized and runs at multiple frames per second. We show that this novel upsampling clearly outperforms state of the art approaches in terms of speed and accuracy on the widely used Middlebury 2007 datasets. Furthermore, we introduce novel datasets with highly accurate groundtruth, which, for the first time, enable to benchmark depth upsampling methods using real sensor data.

articles.title_zh: 使用非同位素总同位素总变异的图像引导深度检测
articles.content_zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了一种解决深度图像取景这一具有挑战性的问题的新方法。 Kinect或飞行时空相机等现代深度相机提供密度高,质量高的深度测量,但其横向分辨率有限. 为了克服这一限制,我们用更高的定序规范来进行深度图像上取样,从而形成一个对流优化问题。 在这种优化中,用从高分辨率强度图像中计算出来的异同位素扩散拉伸来指导上标. 我们基于一个原始配方得出一个数值算法,这种配方是高效地平行的,以多帧每秒运行. 我们显示,这部小说在广泛使用的Middlebury 2007数据集的速度和准确性方面, 提供了明显高于最新艺术水平的样本。 此外,我们引入了具有高度准确的地表真伪的新数据集,首次能够利用真实的传感器数据对深度上下取样方法进行基准测定。

articles.title: TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation
articles.content: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. For each short segment, or chunk, two denoising steps establish coarse video structure at low resolution. A final step refines the video to high resolution, with audio generated throughout the same trajectory. Each stage passes its audiovisual predictions to the same stage of the next chunk as history. Across text updates, the model retains this history to infer what has already been spoken. Continuation training utilizes asymmetric text conditioning, with separate text windows for generation and distillation. Experiments show a 1.6x speedup over direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware. Optimized stage-parallel deployment provides a further 1.9x overall speedup over serial progressive generation. Our continuation training reduces character error rate by 11.18 percentage points relative to the baseline. The model also supports hour-long audiovisual generation. Our project page is https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD.

articles.title_zh: TaoMate-HD: 渐进分辨率自递式音频视频生成
articles.content_zh: 流出数码人类制作出详细的视频,同时随着新文本的到来继续演讲. 高分辨去诺是代价高昂的,文本更新可能导致重复或中断演讲. 我们介绍TaoMate-HD,一种高分辨率音频视频流的自旋模型. 对于每个短段,或分块,两个去声步骤在低分辨率下建立粗糙的视频结构. 最后一步将视频精炼为高分辨度,音频在同一个轨迹中产生. 每个阶段的视听预测都传到与历史相同的下一个阶段。 通过文本更新,模型保留了这一历史来推断已经说过的话。 继续培训采用不对称的文本调制,并设有单独的文本窗口用于生成和蒸馏. 实验显示比起直接高分辨生成,具有相同的模型和硬件的1.6x速度. 最佳的相平行部署比系列相继生成提供了1.9x的总速度. 我们的继续训练比基线降低了11.18个百分点。 该模型还支持长达一小时的视听生成. 我们的项目网页是https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD。

articles.title: TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
articles.content: AI-generated videos often depict people within detailed scenes while leaving their small facial regions poorly resolved. Visual super-resolution can sharpen these regions without resolving whether the recovered lips and teeth agree with the spoken audio. We present an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that addresses this ambiguity within a reference-guided video flow model. Source--noise mixing initializes reconstruction from a partially preserved observation, and structured reference injection separates appearance anchors from continuous motion context. Training combines restoration of degraded images and videos with correction of degraded dubbed sources under target audio. Appearance and synchronization supervision allow the model to recover facial detail and support visual dubbing when the audio is replaced. On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the best paired perceptual similarity and synchronization scores among the compared restoration methods. Component comparisons examine audio conditioning, the reconstruction formulation, and reference injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage. injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage.

articles.title_zh: TaoMate-FVSR:音频引导视频修复
articles.content_zh: AI出品的视频常常在细节的场景中描写人们,同时让自己的小面部区域解不开. 视觉超分辨率可以使这些区域磨合而无需解决恢复的嘴唇和牙齿是否与口语音频一致. 我们提出了一个音频导面部视频修复框架,在参考导视频流模型中处理这一模糊性。 源-噪声相混合从部分保存的观测中初始化了重建,结构化的参考注射将外观锚与连续运动上下文相分离. 培训将恢复已退化的图像和录像与在目标音频下纠正已退化的被誉来源结合起来。 外观和同步监督可以使模型恢复面部细节,并在音频被替换后支持可视化的配音. 在对话头恢复基准方面,我们的方法在比较的恢复方法中实现了最好的对等感知相似性和同步分数。 组成部分比较审查音频调节、重建配方和参考注射。 原生AIGC的例子进一步说明了在场景级镜头中唇形轮廓,牙科结构以及周围面部纹理的恢复. 注射剂 原生AIGC的例子进一步说明了在场景级镜头中唇形轮廓,牙科结构以及周围面部纹理的恢复.

articles.title: Progressive Multi-Scale Super-Resolution via Cascaded Bicubic Anchors and Inter-Scale Mutual Refinement
articles.content: Super-resolution networks are trained for one magnification factor, so several output resolutions require several models. We propose PMS-SR, a progressive single-input multiple-output network that produces x2, x4, and x8 results in one forward pass, with a Transformer backbone on the low-resolution grid. In Stage 1, each scale is predicted as a residual over the detached bicubic upsampling of the previous scale's prediction. With Dirac and zero initialization, training starts exactly from the bicubic cascade, and each head adds only the band the previous scale lacks. In Stage 2, inter-scale mutual refinement couples the scales in both directions through space-to-depth feedback, deformable alignment, and per-pixel fusion, so x8 features refine the x2 output. Trained on DF2K, the 7.95M-parameter model achieves a higher PSNR than every compared multi-scale method at x4 and x8 on all five standard benchmarks. At x8, it outperforms the x8-specific DRN-L on all of them, leads all compared methods on Urban100, and is within 0.13 dB of the best result elsewhere. Against three single-scale SwinIR-M models, PMS-SR uses 22% of the parameters, runs 2.9x faster on BSD100 inputs, and its outputs agree 6.7-12.4 dB more closely. Code and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/julian135707/PMS-SR upon acceptance.

articles.title_zh: 通过连锁比库比克锁定器和跨规模相互改进的渐进式多比例超解
articles.content_zh: 超分辨率网络接受一个放大系数的培训,因此多个输出分辨率需要多个模型. 我们提出PMS-SR,是一个渐进式的单输入多输出网络,生产出x2,x4,而x8的结果是一个前行通路,在低分辨率网格上有一个变压器骨干. 在第一阶段,每个比分被预测为对先前比分的预测进行分解的两比分上下取样的残余. 随着Dirac和零初始化,训练完全从双子级阶梯开始,每个头只添加上个级所缺少的波段. 在第二阶段,通过空间到深度反馈、可变形对接和每像素聚变,对双向的尺度进行大规模相互完善,因此x8特性对x2输出进行了完善。 在DF2K的训练下,7.95M参数模型在所有5个标准基准上,在x4和x8上实现比每个比较多尺度方法更高的PSNR. 在x8时,它的表现超过了所有它们上X8专用的DRN-L,在Urban100上领导所有比较方法,在0.13分贝范围内达到其他地方的最佳结果. 针对三种单相标的SwinIR-M型,PMS-SR使用22%的参数,在BSD100输入上运行速度快到2.9x,其输出更接近于6.7-12.4 dB. 将在https://github.com/julian135707/PMS-SR上发布密码和预先训练过的模型。 接受时。

articles.title: ASCoR: Asymmetric Semantic-Spatial Learning for Remote Sensing Domain Generalization
articles.content: Source-only domain generalization (DG) for remote sensing semantic segmentation seeks reliable predictions in unseen domains without target-domain data during training. Although vision foundation models offer transferable knowledge, category recognition remains sensitive to source-specific visual cues, while task-specific adaptation may weaken pretrained transferability. We propose ASCoR, an asymmetric semantic-spatial framework built on SAM3. Its text-conditioned semantic branch uses class-name prompts to provide explicit category guidance. Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA distributes a fixed adaptation budget across encoder blocks to limit source-specific specialization. A complementary task-specific dense branch learns multi-scale spatial representations using a separate frozen SAM3 image encoder. A lightweight reliability router integrates the two branches through bounded spatial correction based on local prediction reliability. All components are trained using source-domain supervision only. Experiments on the ISPRS, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap benchmarks cover nine cross-domain transfers. ASCoR achieves a state-of-the-art mean IoU of 68.61% across six ISPRS transfers, outperforming the previous best method by 2.69 percentage points. It also achieves the best results on all three LoveDA/OpenEarthMap transfers, with 59.07%, 47.95%, and 49.38% mIoU on Rural-to-Urban, Urban-to-Rural, and Urban-to-OpenEarthMap, respectively. Ablation studies, feature visualizations, and spatial reliability analyses support the effectiveness and complementarity of the proposed components. Code: https://github.com/WangZitong42/ASCoR.

articles.title_zh: ASCoR:遥感领域不对称语义-空间学习
articles.content_zh: 用于遥感语义分解的仅源域通论(DG)在培训期间在没有目标域数据的情况下寻求在未见域中进行可靠的预测. 虽然愿景基础模型提供了可转让的知识,但类别识别仍然对特定源的可视提示敏感,而针对特定任务的适应可能削弱事先经过培训的可转让性。 我们提出ASCoR,一个基于SAM3的不对称语义-空间框架. 它的文字条件语义分支使用类名提示来提供明确的类别指导. Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LORA在编码器块之间分配固定的适应预算,以限制特定源的专门化. 一个互补的任务特有密度分支使用单独的被冷冻的SAM3图像编码器来学习多尺度的空间表示. 轻量级可靠性路由器通过基于局部预测可靠性的有界空间校正来将两个分支整合. 所有组件都只使用源域监督进行训练。 关于ISPRS、LoveDA和OpenEarthMap基准的实验涉及9个跨域转移。 ASCOR在6次ISPRS转移中实现了68.61%的最高水平IoU,比以往最佳方法高2.69个百分点。 它还在LoveDA/OpenEarthMap的所有三项转移中取得了最佳成果,分别有59.07%、47.95%和49.38%的MIoU在农村到城市、城市到农村和城市到OpenEarthMap方面。 校正研究、特征可视化和空间可靠性分析支持拟议组成部分的有效性和互补性。 代码:https://github.com/WangZitong42/ASCoR.

articles.title: Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks
articles.content: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model's response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen's kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. We release all code, labels, and the protocol, and argue benchmarks should report a non-compliance rate and at least two rules, not one unexamined grade.

articles.title_zh: 相同的产出, 不同的分数: 对多式联运LLM 未检查的分数进行审计 基准
articles.content_zh: 每个多模式-LLM多选择基准都以打分规则为结尾,将一个模型的反应,往往是自由形式的文本而不是干净的选项字母,转换成右/错的判决,埋入其代码. 与数据集不同的是,这一规则是在没有正当理由的情况下选择的,并且没有经过审查,然而它却设置了已公布的数字. 我们转载了五个开放式视觉语言模型(VLMs)的8个经同行评审的基准的官方分数,该分数符合单一的16GB GPU,并引入了被盲目的人-+-LLM法官裁决(Cohen's kappa=0.956),恢复了模型实际回答的内容. 单打分规则在相同输出上移动了最多22分的精度,然而,只要一个模型释放出干净的选项字母,则精确的为0分,所以它会隐藏在强模长板上. 造成破坏的是倒行逆施而不是胡言乱语:我们衡量的不遵守情况最高的基准有一个完全为零的产物,因为它的得分者没有猜测,而是投弃权票;不遵守0.000的推理模型仍然摇摆着9.5分,与它所保持的痕迹成正比。 没有标准规则是可靠的:对它最接近的选项入分的答案进行不回答,但从未给过正确答案,弃权者丢弃了用文字表达的答案,而概率分数跟随了答题前题,所以一个单等积分就能用运气来拼凑能力,而不是测量。 我们公布所有代码,标签,协议, 并论证基准应该报告不遵守率和至少两个规则, 而不是一个未经审查的等级。

articles.title: EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation
articles.content: Earth observation (EO) workflows require selecting among known outcomes, estimating confidence, and processing large volumes of imagery. Generative vision-language models can address these tasks, but autoregressive decoding is computationally costly and their confidence estimates are unreliable. Decision models offer an alternative, returning probabilities over candidate answers in a single forward pass. However, their accuracy, calibration, and transfer across EO tasks remain insufficiently understood. We investigate these properties through a diagnostic study of d3-flash (8.4B parameters) across 30 settings from 23 public EO benchmarks. We find that compositional reasoning transfers well and calibration improves over its Qwen3.5-9B backbone on 24 settings, while counting, change quantification, damage grading, and absent-object recognition remain challenging. To address these limitations, we adapt d3-flash through low-rank fine-tuning on public EO training splits, producing EO-Jev. EO-Jev improves significantly over d3-flash on 26 of 30 settings and matches or exceeds specialist references on 20 of 28. It also achieves an average gain of 8.0 points across 12 held-out settings and lower expected calibration error than specialists on 21 of 28 settings. These improvements come at a modest cost of 1.8 points in general decision performance. Our results demonstrate the potential of adapting general decision models into competitive EO generalists while highlighting persistent challenges in quantitative perception, option-order consistency, and calibration under distribution shift.

articles.title_zh: EO-Jev:地球观测决策模型
articles.content_zh: 地球观测工作流程要求在已知结果中作出选择,估计信心并处理大量图像。 基因视觉语言模型可以解决这些任务,但自旋解码在计算上成本高昂,其信心估计不可靠. 决策模式提供了另一种选择,在一次前行通行证中,对候选人的回答有回归概率。 然而,它们之间的准确性、校准和跨道德操守办公室任务的转移仍然不够了解。 我们通过对23个公共道德操守办公室基准中30个环境的d3-flash(8.4B参数)的诊断研究来调查这些属性. 我们发现,在24个设置上,组成推理的转移和校正比Quen3.5-9B主干要好,而计数、改变量化、损害分级和缺失对象识别则仍然具有挑战性。 为解决这些局限性,我们通过对公共道德操守办公室培训的分拆进行低级微调来调整d3-flash,生成了EO-Jev. EO-Jev在30个设置中的26个设置比d3-flash大为改进,在28个设置中的20个设置上匹配或超过专家参考. 它还在12个搁置设置中实现了平均8.0分的增益,比在28个设置中21个设置中的专家更低的预期校正误差. 这些改进在一般决策业绩方面花费了1.8分。 我们的结果显示,在分配转变的情况下,将一般决定模式调整为竞争性的道德操守办公室通才具有潜力,同时强调在定量认知、选择顺序一致性和校准方面持续存在的挑战。

articles.title: Fuse To Align: Multimodal Representation Learning for Retrieval via Hypergraph Regularization
articles.content: Multimodal retrieval must integrate complementary evidence from views that may be missing, noisy, or unequally informative. When a sample provides limited reliable evidence, learning from its views alone can hinder the acquisition of useful retrieval representations. Semantically related training samples may provide complementary observations, yet existing volume-based objectives jointly align modalities within each sample without explicitly enabling information exchange across samples. We therefore propose a training-time hypergraph fusion framework that connects observed modalities both within samples and across semantically related samples, allowing representation learning to draw on evidence beyond an individual sample while leaving the retrieval pipeline unchanged at inference. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and introduces two configurations: wHyVol learns view contribution weights and symmetric semantic affinities, whereas wRHG additionally models typed interactions and participant roles through relational propagation. Missing modalities are omitted rather than imputed, and the hypergraph is discarded after training, incurring no additional inference cost. Experiments on eleven zero-shot video-text and audio-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate broad improvements with both GRAM and HyperGRAM. Across 17 video benchmark-modality settings evaluated in both retrieval directions, wRHG outperforms GRAM in all 34 comparisons and HyperGRAM in 33 of 34. Mean text-to-video R@1 increases from 63.4 to 68.2 with GRAM and from 64.8 to 68.4 with HyperGRAM, while the largest video-to-text gain reaches 13.3 percentage points on ActivityNet. Under missing-modality evaluation, both weighted configurations retain positive text-to-video gains over GRAM across seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate, even when 90% of clips lack one modality.

articles.title_zh: Fuse To Align: 通过Hypergraph 规范化检索的多式联运代表学习
articles.content_zh: 多式联运检索必须综合来自可能缺失、吵闹或信息不均的观点的补充证据。 当样本提供有限的可靠证据时,仅仅从其观点中学习会妨碍获取有用的检索说明. 与语义相关的培训样本可提供补充观测,但现有的量基目标在未明确允许在样本之间交流信息的情况下,在每个样本中联合调整模式。 因此,我们提出一个培训时间超图聚变框架,将样本内部和与标本有关的观察模式联系起来,使代表学习能够吸取单个样本之外的证据,同时使检索管道保持不变,从而推论。 该框架将HyVol作为一个特例,并引入了两种配置:wHyVol学习查看贡献权重和对称语义亲和,而wRHG额外模型通过关系传播输入了互动和参与者角色. 缺失的模式被省略,而不是推算,在培训后,高频图被丢弃,不产生额外的推论费用. 关于11个零镜头视频文本和音频文本检索基准的实验显示,GRAM和HyperGRAM都有了广泛的改进。 在两个检索方向评价的17个视频基准模式设置中,WRHG在所有34个比较中都超过了GRAM,在34个比较中有33个超过了HyperGRAM。 平均文本到视频R@1从GRAM的63.4增加到68.2,HyperGRAM的64.8增加到68.4,而最大的视频到文本收益在ActiveNet上达到13.3个百分点. 在缺失模式评价中,两个加权配置在7个基准中保留了文字对视频的正面收益,每个评估的缺失率,即使90%的剪辑缺乏一种模式。

articles.title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
articles.content:
**Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity.
  **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses.
  **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance.
  **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.

articles.title_zh: 每个像素 Is an option: 医疗超声波生物测量的系统模型
articles.content_zh:
**目的:**超声波生物测量在各种临床应用中被广泛使用,包括产前和心脏检查,通过将卡利佩斯放入解剖地标来得到定量测量. 然而,这些测量仍然受到操作间变异性的影响,因为它们主要依靠手动卡路里定位. 常规方法往往使用专门的预测头来完成不同的超声波任务,而视觉语言模型则通过文本指示提供灵活性. 然而,直接的坐标预测没有明确的模拟空间概率分布,限制了本地化模糊性的表现.
** 方法:** 我们提出Kev-Bio,一种用临床测量问题指导超声波地标探测的视觉语言模型. Kev-Bio在System One决定模型的启发下,使用语言模型的决定表示来生成每个卡利珀端点的查询. 这些查询与共享的密集超声波特征相匹配,生成空间概率图,从中得出地标坐标和临床测量. 该模型是经过培训的端到端,既使用地标化本地化,又使用临床测量损失.
** 成果:** 在九景FU/GU Biometery 2026数据集上,Kev-Bio实现了22.50像素的平均射线误差(MRE)和15.38的临床测量平均绝对误差(MAE),在整体性能上超过了比较基线.
** 结论:** 这些结果显示了Kev-Bio在超声波地标检测和临床测量中在不同解剖观点上的有效性. 我们的代码和模型可查阅https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio。

articles.title: ArabGeoText: Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Models for Arabic Geospatial Text Spotting
articles.content: Geospatial text spotting involves locating and transcribing geographic labels, such as road names, district names, and landmarks, in raster maps. These labels are often small, densely arranged, and arbitrarily oriented. Although Arabic text recognition has been studied extensively in documents and natural scenes, Arabic geospatial text spotting remains underexplored. We introduce ARABGEOTEXT, an Arabic-centric benchmark covering 970 geographic locations in Riyadh and Jeddah, with 17,875 manually annotated text instances per view type. For each location, we pair an OpenStreetMap (OSM) rendering with a composite created by overlaying that rendering on the corresponding remote sensing (RS) imagery. The paired views preserve label content and pixel geometry, allowing evaluation across different backgrounds. Geographic partitions support in-city and city-disjoint evaluation of detection, recognition, and end-to-end spotting. Experiments with direct Qwen3.5-4B spotting show difficulties in recovering all labels within a tile. We therefore propose a tool-augmented vision-language framework that combines YOLO26 localization and crop rectification with Qwen3.5-4B recognition adapted through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The framework outperforms direct LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-4B spotting across both image views and test cities. With localization held fixed, reader adaptation further improves recognition over the pretrained zero-shot reader. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yakoubbazi/ArabGeoText.

articles.title_zh: ArabGeoText:阿拉伯地理空间文本示意图工具强化愿景-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 地理空间文本的定位涉及在光栅图中定位和转录地理标签,如道路名称、区名和地标等。 这些标签往往很小、排列密集并任意取向。 尽管在文件和自然场景中广泛研究了阿拉伯文文本识别,但阿拉伯文地理空间文本的显示仍然没有得到充分利用。 我们采用阿拉伯GEOT,这是一个以阿拉伯为中心的基准,涵盖利雅得和吉达的970个地理位置,每个视图类型有17 875个手动附加说明的文字实例。 对于每个地点,我们把OpenStreetMap(OSM)的渲染与通过在相应的遥感图像上覆盖渲染而创建的复合材料配对。 配对的视图保留了标签内容和像素几何,允许不同背景的评价. 地理分区支持市内和市内对检测,识别,端对端抽查进行联合评价. 直接使用Quen3.5-4B分取的实验显示,在平板内回收所有标签有困难。 因此,我们提出一个工具强化的远景语言框架,将YOLO26本地化和作物整顿与通过低等级调整而适应的Quen3.5-4B识别结合起来(LORA)。 这个框架的效绩超过了直接经过LORA调整的Quen3.5-4B在图像视图和测试城市中所发现的. 随着本地化的固定进行,读者的适应性比预先训练的零镜头阅读器进一步提高了认知. 数据集和代码将在https://github.com/yakoubazi/ArabGeoText上公布。

articles.title: Mesh-Agnostic Refinement Models for Latent Space Encoding of 3D Human Body Shapes
articles.content: Parametric human body models such as the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) model provide compact representations of human shape and pose, but their reconstructions remain affected by both errors in estimated latent parameters and limitations in the decoder's expressive capacity. We propose a framework for refining these reconstructions by exploiting the geometric discrepancy between an initial decoded surface and a target mesh, without requiring vertex correspondences between them. The framework comprises three complementary approaches. Latent-VaRefine uses varifold-distance gradients to correct the estimated latent code while preserving the original parametric representation. Vertex-VaRefine processes multiscale varifold-gradient features with a DiffusionNet backbone to predict vertex displacements in a canonical pose, yielding an approximately pose-equivariant refinement pipeline. ElaOpt directly optimizes surface deformations under elastic regularization and normal-direction constraints.

articles.title_zh: 网络不可知论 改进3D 人体形状的后期空间编码模型
articles.content_zh: Skinned多人线(SMPL)模型等参数人体模型提供了人形和姿势的紧凑表现,但其重建仍然受到估计潜在参数错误和解码器表达能力限制的影响. 我们提出了一个框架,通过利用初步解码的地表与目标网之间的几何相差来改进这些重建,而不需要它们之间的顶点通信。 该框架包括三种相辅相成的办法。 Lententt-Va Refine在保留原始参数化表示的同时,使用变相-相距梯度来修正估计的潜在代码. Vertex-VaRefine处理具有分流网主干线的多尺度变相梯度特性,以预测顶点在峡谷位置上的位置迁移,从而产生大约相当平整的改进管道。 ElaOpt在弹性常态化和正常方向约束下直接优化地表变形.

articles.title: ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors
articles.content: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/

articles.title_zh: ReVA- HPE: 相对的 6DoF 与合成松科监督及个性化虚拟锁定器的Pose估算
articles.content_zh: 单相片头相片估计通常被表述为从单一相片作物的绝对回归,然而许多应用在一段时间内都观察到了同一个人,并可以提供明确的锚地图像. 最近,有人提出相对头姿势估计,这使问题成为对锚和查询图像之间相对几何变化的估计。 然而,现有的方法仍然要求锚地图像的外观在推论中为人所了解,大大限制了其实际使用. 我们首先通过额外预测深度常态化的相对翻译,将相对头部延伸至全6DoF,这种翻译与主机组成,以恢复相机相框中的度量查询姿势. 为了消除对地面真人锚的需要,我们从一个没有标签的入场图像中重建了个性化的相机,并造就了一套有已知姿势的虚拟锚。 该银行通过多锚地共识提供强力旋转假说,而真实的入会图像则通过标志性的PnP作为翻译分支的真正锚地. 我们还引入了一个高效的变体,在入学时一次性摊还了银行成本,之后每个查询都需要一个单一的正对正对相对预测,精确度牺牲有限. 相对的姿势估计器专门接受合成面部渲染的培训,没有真正的姿势监督,伪标签,域名调整,也没有在评价集上进行微调. 在真实的6DoF基准上,ReVA-HPE在BIWI上实现了最先进的旋转精度,并在FaMoS上实现了近前入场图像,同时尽管只依靠合成的外观监督,但仍保持了在量子翻译上的竞争力. 项目页和代码:https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/

articles.title: R$^2$-Omni: Reducing Structural and Precision Redundancy in Omni-LLMs for Long-Form Generation
articles.content: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) typically process large numbers of multimodal tokens from audio-visual inputs, incurring substantial computational costs and a large memory footprint for the key-value (KV) cache. Aggressive token pruning can alleviate this problem while maintaining competitive performance on multiple-choice tasks, which require only a single option as output. However, we observe substantial quality degradation when generating long-form, open-ended responses. We attribute this gap to query-guided selection, which can retain sufficient evidence for answer selection while discarding details needed for comprehensive generation. This motivates reducing overlapping information across tokens, termed structural redundancy, while preserving diverse content. However, the retained representations may still contain precision redundancy due to unnecessarily high numerical precision in their cached values. To address these two levels of redundancy in token representations, we introduce a training-free framework named R$^2$-Omni. First, Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) consolidates redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Then, Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA) allocates value precision to the retained representations according to the estimated reduction in attention-output error under quantized keys, with query attention and audio-visual alignment providing a semantic prior. Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks demonstrate an average 5.0$\times$ reduction in the memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48$\times$ end-to-end speedup, highlighting the benefits of jointly reducing structural and precision redundancy.

articles.title_zh: R$^2$-Omni:减少Omni-LLMs中的结构与精度冗余,供长期世代使用
articles.content_zh: Omni-modle大型语言模型(Omni-LLMs)一般会从视听投入中处理出大量多模式符号,产生大量的计算成本和对密钥值缓存(KV)的巨大内存足迹. 侵略性的代币挤压可以缓解这一问题,同时在多选择任务上保持竞争性表现,这些任务只需要一个作为产出的单一选项. 然而,我们看到,在产生长期、开放的反应时,质量严重退化。 我们将此差距归结为查询指导选择,这种选择可以保留足够的答案选择证据,同时丢弃全面生成所需的细节. 这鼓励减少各种标志(称为结构冗余)的重叠信息,同时保留不同的内容。 但是,保留的陈述可能仍然含有精度冗余,因为其缓存值数字精度不必要地很高。 为了解决象征性表示的这两个冗余级别,我们引入了一个名为R$^2$-Omni的无培训框架。 首先,结构-Aware Token 综合(STC)利用视频的瞬间相近性和音频的局部连续性来整合冗余表示。 然后,语义-敏感度导精度分配(SPA)根据被分解的密钥下注意力输出误差的估计减少,将数值精度分配到所保留的表示上,而查询注意力和视听对接提供语义前. 对长式生成基准的广泛试验表明,记忆足迹平均减少5.0美元,同时保留了基准生成质量的97.98%并实现了1.48美元到末端加速,突出了联合减少结构冗余和精密冗余的好处。

articles.title: HyperFlow: Class-Incremental Semantic Change Detection via Hyperbolic Flow
articles.content: Semantic change detection in remote sensing aims to identify and characterize land-cover transitions observed in pairs of satellite or aerial images. Existing methods assume a fixed set of change categories, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where changes of interest may vary, for example across geographies or over time. In this work, we tackle the problem of class-incremental semantic change detection, where a model progressively learns to detect new types of semantic change. To do so, we exploit the hierarchical structure of land-cover semantics, where newly introduced categories correspond to fine-grained refinements of existing ones, and represent said semantic categories in hyperbolic space, which is particularly well suited to represent such hierarchical relationships. To capture semantic changes, we introduce HyperFlow, a method relying on Busemann prototypes, modeling change as an anomaly in a learned semantic flow within the hyperbolic embedding space induced by segmentation. HyperFlow couples change detection to class-incremental semantic segmentation, enabling class-incremental semantic change detection. We also present HiChange, a new large-scale, high resolution remote sensing dataset with detailed, fine-grained hierarchical labels. Experimental results demonstrate that HyperFlow achieves both strong change detection and semantic segmentation performance across incremental steps. In particular, we show that progressively refining semantic categories, rather than considering them all directly, yields improved change detection, highlighting the benefits of incremental learning for semantic change detection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HyperFlow:通过Hyperbolic流量进行类-递增语义变化检测
articles.content_zh: 遥感中的语义变化探测旨在识别和描述在对等卫星或航空图像中观测到的土地覆盖过渡。 现有方法假设一套固定的改变类别,限制其在实际世界情景中的适用性,而这种情景中的兴趣变化可能有所不同,例如在地理上或随着时间推移而变化。 在这部作品中,我们解决了阶级-增量语义变化探测问题,一个模型逐渐学会了检测新型语义变化. 为此,我们利用了土地覆盖语义的分级结构,新引入的分类对应了对现有分类的精细完善,并在双曲空间中代表了所说的语义分类,这特别适合代表这种分级关系. 为了捕捉语义变化,我们引入了HyperFlow,一种依靠布斯曼原型的方法,将变化建模为被分化所诱导的双曲嵌入空间内有学问的语义流中的异常. HyperFlow夫妇更改检测为类增量语义分解,使类增量语义分解检测成为可能. 我们还提出了Hichange, 一个新的大规模高分辨率遥感数据集, 带有详细,细微的分级标签。 实验结果表明,HyperFlow既能实现强变化检测,又能实现跨增量步骤的语义分解性能. 特别是,我们表明,逐步完善语义分类,而不是直接考虑所有类别,会产生更好的变化探测,突出了增量学习对语义变化探测的好处.

articles.title: Calibrating Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation under Reliability and Availability Modality Shifts
articles.content: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) enables pretrained multimodal models to accommodate distribution shifts during inference using only unlabeled test data, without recourse to the original training data. Compared with unimodal adaptation, multimodal adaptation is further complicated by the coexistence and interaction of multiple representation perspectives. This complexity is particularly pronounced under modality reliability shifts, which preserve modality availability but degrade information quality, and modality availability shifts, which render the corresponding modality entirely inaccessible. Category-conditional Gaussian modeling offers a natural starting point for handling such distributional variations, having proven effective in unimodal test-time adaptation for characterizing representation distributions, yet its extension to multimodal settings requires a more elaborate formulation. To this end, we propose Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration (AdaPGC), which extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling across modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations for probabilistic calibration under multimodal distribution shifts. AdaPGC continuously updates category-conditional Gaussian models over modality-specific and fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model predictions and guide reliability based rectification, while exploiting their joint distributions to recover unavailable fusion representations. Extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC effectively improves robustness under both modality reliability and availability shifts. Our source code will be released at https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 校正多式 可靠性和可用性模式变化下的试验-时间适应
articles.content_zh: 多式联运测试时间适应(TTA)使得预先训练的多式联运模型能够在推论中仅使用无标签的测试数据来适应分布变化,而无需使用原始的培训数据. 与单一模式适应相比,多种代表性观点的共存和互动使多式联运适应更加复杂。 这种复杂性在模式可靠性变化中尤为突出,这种变化保留了模式的可用性,但降低了信息质量,模式可用性变化使得相应的模式完全无法使用。 类-有条件的高斯模型为处理这种分布性变化提供了自然的起点,在单一模式测试时间调整中证明对表示性分布的定性是有效的,但将这种模型扩展至多模式环境需要更细致的表述。 为此,我们提出适应性概率高斯校正(AdaPGC),将类别有条件的高斯模型扩展至特定模式和多模式聚变表示,以便在多模式分配转移下进行概率校正。 AdaPGC不断更新条件类高斯模型超过模式特异性和聚变表示,利用由此产生的概率预测来校正源模型预测并引导基于可靠性的校正,同时利用其联合分布来恢复无法得到的聚变表示. 在多种模式下进行的广泛实验表明,AdaPGC在模式可靠性和可用性转变下有效地提高了稳健性。 我们的源代码将在https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus上发布.

articles.title: CL3DOD: Understanding the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Outdoor Class-Incremental 3D Object Detection
articles.content: Class-incremental learning (CIL) for outdoor 3D object detection remains largely underexplored. Existing outdoor studies are limited to single-benchmark evaluations, with SDCoT++ considering KITTI and CL2OD considering nuScenes under different incremental settings. This makes it difficult to assess whether observed continual-learning behavior generalizes across autonomous-driving benchmarks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of outdoor class-incremental 3D object detection across multiple autonomous-driving benchmarks, covering both two-task and multi-stage settings. We investigate: (1) how severely existing 3D detectors forget previously learned classes, (2) how incremental training exposes the stability-plasticity dilemma between knowledge retention and new-class acquisition, and (3) which forms of supervision are most effective for balancing these objectives. We introduce CL3DOD, a class-incremental 3D detection framework that restores missing supervision for previous classes using predictions from the previous-stage detector, preserves old-class responses through query-wise knowledge distillation, and employs EMA-based temporal consistency regularization. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes reveal a consistent stability-plasticity dilemma across both benchmarks. CL3DOD generally achieves a more favorable stability-plasticity balance than controlled incremental baselines and improves upon published prior methods in the reported benchmark comparisons. This advantage persists across multiple incremental stages, demonstrating strong retention of previously learned knowledge while maintaining effective new-class acquisition. Our code, evaluation setup, and incremental task splits will be publicly released.

articles.title_zh: CL3DOD:了解户外类-增量类3D物体检测中的稳定性-弹性难题
articles.content_zh: 用于室外3D物体探测的班级增收学习(CIL)仍然基本上未得到充分探索. 现有的室外研究仅限于单基准评价,SDCOT++考虑KITTI,CL2OD考虑不同增量环境下的nuScenes. 这使得难以评估所观察到的持续学习行为是否贯穿于自主驾驶基准。 据我们所知,我们首先对跨越多个自主驾驶基准的室外类增量3D物体检测进行统一的跨基准分析,涵盖双任务和多阶段设置. 我们调查:(1) 现有3D探测器如何严重地忘记了以前学到的课;(2) 增量培训如何暴露出知识保留和新级获取之间的稳定性-可塑性两难境地;(3) 何种监督形式对平衡这些目标最为有效. 我们引入了CL3DOD,这是一个分级递增的3D检测框架,它利用前相探测器的预测恢复了前相类缺失的监管,通过查询知识分解保留了旧相干响应,并采用了基于EMA的时间一致性规范. 关于KITTI和nuScens的实验表明,在两个基准中,稳定-可塑性一直处于两难境地。 一般而言,CL3DOD比控制下增量基线更能实现稳定性-可塑性平衡,并在报告的基准比较中公布的先前方法后有所改进。 这一优势在多个渐进阶段持续存在,表明在保持有效新级获取的同时,保留了以往学到的知识。 我们的代码,评价设置,以及增量任务划分将公开发布.

articles.title: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
articles.content: Most image-based 3D reconstructors primarily recover visible surfaces, producing partial point clouds with large holes and leaving unobserved geometry unresolved. To address this limitation, we introduce AnchorComplete, a framework that reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds while preserving observed geometry and supporting scenes of varying scales. Building on TRELLIS.2, our method combines partial-point conditioning, which integrates global scene tokens with local spatial evidence to anchor generation to the input, and metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, which progressively refines scene geometry within fixed-size windows while maintaining global structural consistency. Experiments on Replica and SCRREAM demonstrate that AnchorComplete consistently outperforms strong baselines in complete-scene reconstruction, particularly under sparse-view settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 锁定完成 : 从局部点云回收完整的场景 Meshes
articles.content_zh: 大多数基于图像的3D重建器主要回收可见地表,产生有大孔的部分点云并留下未观测到的几何问题未解决. 为解决这一局限性,我们引入了AnchorComplete,这个框架从部分点云重建完整的场景网,同时保留观测到的几何和不同尺度的支持场景. 在TRELLIS.2的基础上,我们的方法结合了部分点调,将全局场景符号与局部空间证据相融合,将生成物锁定在输入物上;并结合了公制尺度粗到细的生成物,在固定大小窗口内逐步完善场景几何,同时保持全球结构一致性. 关于复制品和SCREAM的实验表明,AnchorComplete在完全景地重建中,特别是在景地稀疏的环境下,其业绩始终超过强有力的基线。

articles.title: MoSoLoco: Monocular 3D Human Localization through Visual Latent Features and Social Context
articles.content: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.

articles.content_zh: 从单相机中估计人们的度量3D位置对机器人导航和运动预测很重要. 轻量级姿势本地化器对计算资源有限的机器人硬件具有吸引力,因为它们在紧凑的2D键点上运行. 然而,它们通常放弃了由姿势估计者计算的更丰富的视觉表现。 我们引入了MoSoLoco,一种每帧单相单相的3D人本地化器,它结合了姿势探测器的内部视觉特征和被探测到的2D骨架,而不需要额外的RGB或深度编码. MoSoLoco可以进一步纳入稀疏的同框多人背景,来完善单个位置估计. 对JRDB和NuScens的实验表明,重新使用姿势探测器的表示可以改善本地化,相对于最强的经评价的以关键点为基础的基线,JRDB最佳出错减少约23%. 一个稀少的社会互动模块包含来自同一图像的相邻检测,以作进一步完善。 所控制的轨迹预测实验显示出下游的好处,而完整的管道仍然适合高效的Jetson AGX Xavier推断.

articles.title: Visual-to-Executable Procedural Reconstruction of Buildings
articles.content: Procedural modeling offers compact, editable, and reusable representations for architectural content, but building such models still depends heavily on manually authored grammars. We study image-based procedural building reconstruction from in-the-wild images, with the goal of recovering an executable procedural description that can be instantiated as an editable 3D building asset. Because a single image provides only partial and view-dependent evidence, we focus on recovering the dominant visible facade(s) and attach the recovered facade program to a simple mass model for building-level instantiation. Our method decomposes this task into two structured prediction stages. First, a Global Structure Layout Tree recovers facade-scale split-and-repeat organization through a fine-tuned layout model with render-guided visual-symbolic reflection. Second, a Component Parameterization schema maps representative facade tiles to structured procedural attributes for local architectural component synthesis. These two representations are then deterministically compiled into executable Computer Generated Architecture (CGA) programs, avoiding the brittleness of direct low-level program generation. Experiments show that the proposed framework handles both regular facades and challenging in-the-wild images, while maintaining high structural consistency, procedural executability, and fine-grained architectural detail. The recovered programs further enable controllable and reusable 3D building asset generation.

articles.title_zh: 建筑物的可视对可执行程序重建
articles.content_zh: 程序模型为建筑内容提供紧凑,可编辑,可再用的说明,但这种模型的建设仍然很大程度上依赖于手动编写的语法. 我们研究以图像为基础的程序建筑重建,以恢复可执行的程序描述,作为可编辑的3D建筑资产。 因为单一的图像只提供部分的和取景性的证据,所以我们专注于恢复占优势的可见外观(s),并将所恢复的外观程序附加在建筑层即时化的简单质量模型上. 我们的方法将这项任务分解为两个结构化的预测阶段. 第一,全球结构布局 树恢复外观尺度分化再生组织,通过有渲染导视觉-同声反射的微调布局模型. 其次,一个组件参数化的图案将具有代表性的外观图片映射为局部建筑组件合成的结构化程序属性. 后将这两种表示方式定型地编译为可执行的计算机生成架构(CGA)程序,避免了直接低等程序生成的脆性. 实验显示,拟议框架既处理正版外观,又处理有挑战性的内在图像,同时保持高结构一致性,程序可执行性,并有精细的纹理建筑细节. 回收后的程序进一步使可控制和可再用3D建筑资产生成成为可能。

articles.title: When Optimization Meets Human Intent: Human-Centered Diffusion Model Optimization
articles.content: Diffusion models are evolving from general tools into personalized systems that adapt to user needs through fine-tuning and guidance. However, diffusion optimization mainly targets measurable objectives such as aesthetics, rarely examining whether they align with human intent. Human needs are multidimensional, contextual, and dynamic, whereas existing methods approximate them with fixed metrics. Because these metrics capture human needs only partially and may amplify deviations from true intent during optimization, higher scores need not yield results better matching human expectations. To understand how human needs enter and influence optimization, we systematically analyze how human intent is expressed, translated into optimizable objectives, applied to model behavior or generation, and evaluated through outputs. We further discuss trade-offs affecting human-intent alignment in personalized image generation and gaps between automated metrics and real user judgments. This human-centered synthesis reorganizes diffusion optimization and provides a systematic reference for personalized generation systems designed for human preferences.
