articles.title_zh: 当优化满足人类意向时:以人为中心的传播模式优化
articles.content_zh: 传播模式正在从一般工具演变成个性化系统,通过微调和指导适应用户需要. 然而,传播优化主要针对美学等可衡量的目标,很少审查这些目标是否与人类意图相符合. 人类需求是多层面的、内在的和动态的,而现有方法则与固定的衡量标准相近。 由于这些衡量标准只捕捉到人类的部分需要,并可能扩大在优化期间偏离真实意图的情况,因此,较高的分数不需要产生更符合人类期望的结果。 为了了解人类的需求是如何进入和影响优化的,我们系统地分析人类意图是如何表达的,如何转化为可选择的目标,如何应用到行为模型或生成模型,以及如何通过产出来评价。 我们进一步讨论了影响人与人之间个人形象生成一致性的取舍,以及自动化衡量尺度与实际用户判断之间的差距。 这种以人为中心的合成重组了传播优化,为为人取向设计的个性化生成系统提供了系统参考.

articles.title: Znaki: A Russian Fingerspelling Recognition Dataset
articles.content: Fingerspelling - the sequential signing of letters that compose proper names, technical terms, and out-of-vocabulary words - is an integral component of any sign language. Despite Russian Sign Language (RSL) being used by more than 150,000 native signers, no public fingerspelling dataset for RSL exists, in contrast to American, British, German, and several other sign languages. We introduce Znaki the first open RSL fingerspelling dataset: 37,252 video recordings (35.4 hours) of 1,593 unique sequences - proper names sampled from 16 domain categories - recorded by 68 native RSL signers (37 Deaf, 29 hard-of-hearing, and 2 certified interpreters) through a crowdsourcing pipeline with a two-stage signer qualification procedure and expert validation. The dataset covers all 33 Cyrillic handshapes, and its letter-frequency distribution matches the Russian National Corpus. As reference points for future research, we establish two baselines adapted from American Sign Language fingerspelling recognition: a Squeezeformer-based encoder-decoder, reaching a character-level accuracy ($1-\mathrm{CER}$) of 0.932 and a sequence accuracy of 0.596, and Fingerspelling-PoseNet, reaching 0.886 and 0.545, respectively.

articles.title: Behavioral Affinity Transduction for Zero-Shot Vision-Language Classification
articles.content: An image that is hard to classify on its own may have a helpful neighbor in the same unlabeled batch. Zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) score images independently and leave this evidence unused. We study small unlabeled query batches with no labeled examples. Visual similarity can reflect pose or background, so it may connect images from different classes. Each image's scores over the class vocabulary offer another way to choose neighbors. We introduce Behavioral Affinity Transduction (BAT), which builds a sparse graph from these class-response profiles. The graph supplies neighbor evidence during prediction. For EM-Dirichlet, it also screens candidate classes and initializes assignments. BAT plugs into direct and iterative readouts of a frozen VLM. Across diverse datasets, BAT improves the mean accuracy of every tested readout. In the main RN50 comparison, soft and hard EM-Dirichlet gain $4.22$ and $2.72$ percentage points.

articles.title_zh: 零热视线-语言分类行为全能转换
articles.content_zh: 一个很难单独分类的图像可能在同一没有标签的批次中有一个有帮助的邻居. 零镜头视觉语言模型(VLMs)对图像进行独立分分,并留下这些证据未被使用. 我们研究没有标签的小型查询批次,没有标签的例子。 视觉相似性可以反映姿势或背景,因此可以连接不同类的图像. 每个图像的分数超过类词汇提供了另一种选择邻居的方法. 我们介绍了行为无穷转移(BAT),它从这些类反应剖面中构建出一个稀有的图. 该图在预测时提供相邻证据. 对于EM-Dirichlet,它也筛选候选班级并初始化分配. BAT插件直接并迭接地读取被冻结的VLM. 在整个不同的数据集中,最佳可得技术提高了每次测试的读出的平均准确度. 在RN50主比较中,软硬EM-Dirichlet获得4.22美元和2.72分.

articles.title: SurgPace: Complexity-Aware Progressive Distillation for Surgical Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential in robotic surgery for question answering, scene understanding, and grounded assistance, but their high computational cost limits real clinical deployment. Knowledge distillation provides a practical way to build compact surgical MLLMs, yet direct distillation is not well suited to surgical data because surgical samples vary greatly in difficulty, visual ambiguity, and required clinical context, making uniform teacher-student transfer unstable. In addition, the role of supervision changes during training: early stages require stronger teacher guidance for multimodal alignment, while later stages rely more on task supervision for effective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. SurgPace estimates sample complexity using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency, and uses the fused score to guide a continuous easy-to-hard training process. We further introduce hierarchical representation alignment, which aligns the student with the teacher at the feature, logit, and probability levels, while gradually shifting the training focus from teacher imitation to task supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling, leading to more stable and effective distillation. We evaluate SurgPace on Surg-396K, a benchmark built from four public surgical datasets and covering five dialogue paradigms. SurgPace consistently outperforms strong MLLM distillation baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for building compact, memory-efficient surgical MLLMs with faster decoding under controlled benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace.

articles.title_zh: SurgPace:外科多式大型语言模型的复杂度- 智能渐进分级
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在机器人手术中显示出很强的潜力,用于回答问题,场景理解和被禁助,但其高计算成本限制了真正的临床部署. 知识分馏为构建紧凑的外科MLLMS提供了实用的方法,而直接分馏并不太适合外科数据,因为外科样本在难度,视觉模糊度,以及所需临床环境等方面差异很大,使得统一的师生转移不稳定. 此外,在培训期间,监督改变的作用:早期阶段要求教师对多式联运的调整提供更强有力的指导,而后阶段则更多地依靠任务监督来有效优化。 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议使用SurgPace,这是逐步分解外科视觉语言模型的复杂而持续的课程框架。 SurgPace使用预测置信度和Lorentz几何一致性来估计样本复杂度,并使用被引信分数来指导连续的易硬化训练过程. 我们进一步实行分级代表制,使学生与教师在特征、记录和概率水平上保持一致,同时逐步将培训重点从教师模仿转向任务监督。 这种设计将样本级课程与目标级日程区分开来,导致更稳定有效的蒸馏. 我们在Surg-396K上评价SurgPace,这是由四个公共外科数据集建立的基准,涵盖五个对话范式. SurgPace持续超过强力的MLLM分馏基准,显示出其对构建紧凑,内存高效的外科MLLMs,在受控基准下更快地解码的有效性. 代码见https://github.com/hezhicheng 2002/SurgPace。

articles.title: KAUSTics-Net: Diffusion-Based Through-Water UAV Restoration with a Semi-Synthetic Dataset
articles.content: Accurate mapping of shallow-water environments using unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenged by water-induced distortions, including refraction, caustics, and wavelength-dependent attenuation. The scarcity of paired distorted and reference imagery further limits the development of supervised restoration methods. To address this challenge, we introduce KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset combining 1,280 reference patches derived from 32 high-resolution UAV images with 12,800 degraded observations generated through Blender-based water-surface rendering and empirical color and blur augmentations. We further propose KAUSTics-Net, a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework integrating a multi-scale conditional encoder, feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), cross-attention, and a composite reconstruction objective to restore shallow-water imagery. We evaluated the framework against eight image-restoration methods, complemented by architectural ablations and cross-dataset experiments. On KAUSTics, KAUSTics-Net achieved a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 31.715 +/- 0.439 dB, structural similarity index (SSIM) of 0.849 +/- 0.002, and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) of 0.145 +/- 0.007 across three training seeds. On the independent Sea-Undistort dataset, sampler-aware fine-tuning improved restoration fidelity, reaching 19.469 +/- 0.332 dB PSNR and 0.554 +/- 0.005 SSIM under combined water-surface distortions, although perceptual trade-offs remained. Additional experiments on real UAV imagery examined feature preservation and segmentation behavior. These findings demonstrate the potential of semi-synthetic training and conditional diffusion for shallow-water image restoration while highlighting the importance of evaluating both reconstruction fidelity and downstream remote-sensing utility.

articles.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting within Self-Learned Neural View-Dependent Color Fields
articles.content: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a vital tool in novel view synthesis. 3D Gaussian functions with attributes like color, opacity, and scale are stacked together to explicitly model a radiance field. However, discrete 3D Gaussians usually produce poor depth with few geometry details but lots of floaters, which hinders the effective modeling of smooth radiance fields. To address this issue, we propose to learn a radiance field within a continuous view-dependent color field parameterized by neural networks. With continuous constraints in color, the bias on low-frequency signals of neural networks can highly encourage the geometry modeling to contribute to high-frequency color variations on images, getting rid of solely relying on the color attribute itself. Moreover, we impose a constraint to improve the Lipschitz continuity of the neural color field, making large changes of each Gaussian's color also match with large changes of its position in terms of a ratio. To this end, we additionally introduce novel self-learning strategies to improve the learning of the neural view-dependent color field without any external knowledge or priors, aiming for better generalization on unseen scenes. Our numerical and visual comparisons on widely used benchmarks justify our idea and show better ability of high fidelity geometry recovery in 3DGS. Project page: https://github.com/yangyixi21/Neural-Color-Fields-3DGS.

articles.title_zh: 3D 高斯在自学神经视图- 依赖性彩色字段内的平板
articles.content_zh: 3D高斯平板(3DGS)已经成为了小说取景合成中的一个重要工具. 带有色彩,不透明等属性的3D高斯函数和相尺度被堆放在一起,以明确建模出出一发光场. 然而,离散的3D高斯人通常会产生低深,几何细节很少,但多有浮子,这阻碍了平滑光场的有效模型化. 为了解决这个问题,我们建议在神经网络所分解的连续视线依赖色域参数内学习一个光域. 由于颜色持续受限,神经网络对低频信号的偏好可以高度地鼓励几何模型在图像上促进高频颜色变异,被完全依靠色彩属性本身而摆脱. 此外,我们施加了一种限制,以改善神经色域的利普希茨连续性,使每个高斯人颜色的巨大变化也与其在一个比例上的位置的巨大变化相匹配. 为此,我们进一步引入了新颖的自学策略来改进对神经视线依赖的色彩场的学习,而没有任何外部知识或前科,目的是在看不见的场景上更好的概括. 我们对广泛使用的基准进行数字和视觉比较,说明我们的想法是有道理的,并表明在3DGS中,高忠诚度几何恢复能力更强。 项目网页:https://github.com/yangyixi21/Neural-Color-Fields-3DGS.

articles.title: Multimodal Prompt Learning with Dual-Granularity Contrastive Alignment for Preoperative Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma Invasiveness Using 3D CT
articles.content: Accurate preoperative prediction of lung adenocarcinoma invasiveness is important for surgical planning and individualized treatment. However, overlapping CT appearances make it challenging to distinguish invasive adenocarcinoma (IAD) from Pre-IAD lesions. We propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework with dual-granularity image-text alignment for 3D CT-based IAD classification. A 3D ResNet-CBAM encoder extracts global and spatial visual features. A frozen RadBERT backbone is adapted with separate learnable prompts for report-level and keyword-level text encoding. These prompts are initialized using semantic representations derived from real-world clinical reports. Global contrastive alignment connects whole-volume CT representations with reports generated from clinician-annotated radiological attributes to provide overall semantic supervision. A multiple instance learning-based local alignment module associates spatial CT features with vascular-focused radiological keywords, to capture local imaging characteristics potentially associated with tumor invasion. The framework jointly optimizes classification and alignment objectives, while inference requires only CT images. Experiments included 1,593 pathologically confirmed nodules. On the test set, the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 87.92%, F1-score of 87.78%, and AUC of 0.9499. Its AUC significantly exceeded that of the image-only Res-CBAM baseline with the same visual backbone (0.9297; DeLong test, p = 0.0078). Ablation analyses supported the complementary contributions of global and local alignment and the benefit of report-based prompt initialization. Qualitative visualizations showed activation within nodules and adjacent vascular structures. These findings suggest that dual-granularity radiological supervision can enhance CT-based invasiveness prediction while preserving a CT-only inference workflow.

articles.title_zh: 使用3D CT进行多模式快速学习
articles.content_zh: 准确预测肺腺癌入侵性对手术规划和个性化治疗很重要。 然而,重叠的CT外观使得难以区分入侵性腺癌(IAD)与IAD前的损伤. 我们提议采用一个多模式的即时学习框架,对基于3D CT的IAD分类进行双向图像-文本相接。 一个3D ResNet-CBAM编码器提取出全球和空间视觉特征. 一个被冷冻的RadBERT主干线被调整,为报告级和关键词级的文本编码提供了单独的可学习提示. 这些提示是用从现实世界临床报告中衍生出来的语义表达来初始化的. 全球对照一致将全卷的CT表述与临床医生附加说明的放射性属性生成的报告相连接,以提供全面语义监督。 一个多实例的以学习为基础的局部对接模块将空间CT特征与以血管为重点的放射性关键词联系起来,以捕捉可能与肿瘤入侵相伴的局部成像特征. 该框架共同优化了分类和对齐目标,而推论只需要CT图像. 实验包括1 593个经病理鉴定的结核。 在测试中,拟议方法的精度达到87.92%,F1-分数达到87.78%,AUC达到0.9499. 它的AUC大大地超过了仅以图像为主线的Res-CBAM基线(0.9297;DeLong测试,p=0.0078). 差距分析支持了全球和地方协调的互补贡献以及基于报告的快速初始化的好处。 定性可视化显示结核和相邻血管结构内的活性。 这些调查结果表明,双光度辐射监督可以加强基于CT的入侵性预测,同时保留一个仅以CT为主的推断工作流程.

articles.title: Ray-SCR: Generalizing Scene Coordinate Regression Across Camera Models
articles.content:
Among visual localization strategies, scene coordinate regression (SCR) has emerged as an attractive approach for its compactness, accuracy, and speed. Despite these advantages, SCR models generalize poorly across substantially different camera models, such as omnidirectional or strongly rectified imagery. This limitation arises because, changes in field of view, lens distortion, or rectification-induced resampling can make the same scene content appear differently depending on its pixel position, degrading localization accuracy. To cope with this limitation, we introduce Ray-SCR, a lightweight extension to existing SCR architectures that conditions local visual features on their calibrated viewing rays and refines neighboring ray-conditioned features with a shallow local Transformer. We further formulate supervision directly in ray space and use sparse SfM points as metric anchors that link observations across views and camera models. Taken together, these components enable a single scene representation built from a panoramic mapping sequence to accurately localize query images captured with very different cameras, including pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras.
  We evaluate Ray-SCR across multiple SCR architectures and on datasets with pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. The proposed ray conditioning substantially improves generalization across cameras and leads to state-of-the-art localization performance in these challenging cross-camera settings. The project page is available at https://jaeminch0.github.io/ray-scr-generalizing-scene-coordinate-regression-across-camera-models/.

articles.title_zh: 雷-SCR:通用相机相机相机坐标回转模型
articles.content_zh:
在视觉本地化战略中,场景坐标回归(SCR)已成为其紧凑性,准确性和速度的有吸引力的方法. 尽管有这些优点,SCR模型在大相机模型中普遍不善,例如全向或强烈修正的图像。 这种限制之所以产生,是因为视域的变化,镜头扭曲,或矫正所引发的再印可以使同场景内容根据其像素位置的不同而出现不同,降低本地化的准确性. 为了应付这种限制,我们引入了Ray-SCR,这是对现有SCR建筑的轻量级扩展,在它们校准的取景光上设置了局部视觉特征,并用浅度局部变形器来完善相邻的射线条件特征. 我们进一步在射线空间直接制定监督办法,并使用稀疏的SfM点作为将各种观测和相机模型联系起来的度量锚. 综合起来,这些组件使得从全景绘图序列中构建的单一场景代表能够准确定位用非常不同的相机捕获的查询图像,包括针孔,鱼眼和全向相机.
我们评价雷-SCR 跨越多个SCR架构 和数据集 针孔,鱼眼,全向相机。 拟议的射线调节大大地改善了跨相机的通俗化,并导致在这些具有挑战性的跨相机环境中最先进的本地化性能. 项目网页见https://jaeminch0.github.io/ray-scr-generation-scene-concord-rescoverion-across-camera-models/。

articles.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.

articles.title_zh: 博士像素: Page- Native 深度研究与视野-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 科学论文等复杂文件在表格,数字和等式中包含丰富的信息;然而,现有的深入研究(DR)代理人通常会将论文减少为OCR所取出的案文. 相反,我们询问,视觉语言模型(VLMs)是否可以进行页内深入研究:直接检索和推理所制作的文件页图像。 我们引入了DR Pixel,这是第一个使用已渲染的页面图像作为唯一检索和推理单元的开源端到端多模式DR代理,运行于1.06M页的集合上. 为了评估这一设置,我们构建了DRPixel Bench,这是科学论文的基准,需要从文字、数字、表格和等式上进行推理。 出人意料的是,网页原生DR在未经培训的情况下已经取得了良好效果,在GPT-5.4,双子座-3.5-Flash,Qune3.6-27B等最先进的模型上表现优于基于OCR的基线,同时需要更少的工具呼叫. 我们接下来是DR训练。 一项关键的挑战在于,教师对代理制导微调的轨迹很吵,把批评推理和行动步骤与多余或失败的尝试相混合。 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了反事实信用再加权法,这是一种精细的信用分配方法,它通过个人推理和行动步骤对最终答案的反事实贡献进行加权。 我们的培训提高了大约15分的检索率,在DRPixel Bench上提高了10分以上的最后准确度,同样也超过了四个现有基准上未经培训的基线。 关于分配外的ViDoRe-V3, DR 像素在直接给予金页的甲骨文1.8分之内. 我们的结果表明,传统的OCR-当时的检索管道不仅没有必要,而且不尽人意:直接检索和对可视文件页的推理使复杂的DR既更有效又更有效率。

articles.title: MIRA: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Deceptive Contextual Augmentation
articles.content: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced multimodal reasoning, existing frameworks suffer from a critical "perception-reasoning gap." Due to an over-reliance on seemingly relevant visual tokens, even minor perceptual perturbations can propagate through the reasoning process, leading to compounding hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose MIRA, a training framework that improves robustness to erroneous visual contexts while enhancing logical reasoning ability. By injecting filtered, deceptive visual contexts during training, we construct challenging "hard traps" that stress-test the model's robustness to misleading information. Furthermore, we introduce a group-wise reflection-triggering mechanism that enables the model to autonomously detect and rectify inconsistencies between visual cues and logical constraints, which is ultimately internalized as an intrinsic policy behavior. Importantly, MIRA does not rely on human annotations. Experimental results across multiple reasoning and perception benchmarks show that MIRA yields an average 7% improvement on in-domain benchmarks, with consistent improvements on vision-centric benchmarks. These findings highlight that active error recovery is essential for robust multimodal reasoning. Comprehensive ablation studies and analyses further provide insights into why MIRA is effective.

articles.title_zh: MIRA:通过欺骗性上下文增强多式联运
articles.content_zh: 虽然用可验证的奖励进行强化学习(RLVR)已显著地推进了多式推理,但现有的框架却存在"感知-理性差距". 由于过度依赖看似相关的视觉标志,即使是微小的感官扰动也能通过推理过程来传播,导致复合幻觉. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立MIRA这一培训框架,在增强逻辑推理能力的同时,改善对错误视觉环境的稳健性。 通过在训练中注入被过滤的,欺骗性的视觉环境,我们构建了具有挑战性的"硬陷阱",这种"硬陷阱"将压力测试模型的坚固度来测试误导信息. 此外,我们引入了一个分组反射-触发机制,使模型能够自主地发现和纠正视觉提示和逻辑制约之间的不一致,这最终被内化为内在的政策行为. 重要的是,MIRA不依靠人的描述。 跨多个推理和感知基准的实验结果表明,MIRA比域内基准平均提高7%,而以愿景为中心的基准也不断得到改进。 这些结论突出表明,积极追回出错对于有力的多式联运推理至关重要。 全面的审阅研究和分析进一步揭示了MIRA为何有效。

articles.title: VL-Dedup: Graded Multimodal Entity Resolution for Image-Text Data Deduplication
articles.content: Image-text corpora contain copies of one image, captions that describe one image in different ways, captions reused for different images, and captions that do not match their images. Each case calls for a different curation action. Deduplication and multimodal entity resolution (ER) only decide whether records are the same, and they are evaluated on labeled pairs. Yet pair scores do not tell which records end up in the same cluster or which useful captions get deleted. We therefore formulate image-text deduplication as graded multimodal ER, which decides visual identity, caption handling, and mismatches for each pair, and we evaluate it at three levels: pairs, clusters, and the retained set. Our method, VL-Dedup, groups records of the same visual entity into clusters and caps the size of each cluster. Within each cluster, a vision-language model (VLM) and CLIPScore decide which captions to keep and which to flag. We also build VL-DedupBench, with 50,000 COCO and SOP records and 66,788 labeled pairs. On it, a classifier that selects no false edge among the labeled pairs still joins millions of record pairs from different entities. Spending VLM calls on the pairs inside clusters, rather than on pairs with uncertain scores, gives better caption decisions from the same model. Even when almost all clusters are correct, keeping one record per cluster loses facts in many deletions, while the deletions of VL-Dedup lose much less information.

articles.title_zh: VL- Dedup: 图像文本数据复制的分级多模式实体分辨率
articles.content_zh: 图像文本corpora包含一个图像的复制件,以不同方式描述一个图像的字幕,重复使用不同图像的字幕,以及不符合其图像的字幕. 每个案件都需要不同的惩罚行动。 复制和多模式实体分辨率(ER)只决定记录是否相同,并在有标签的对上加以评价。 然而对子分数却无法分辨哪些记录最终会在同一组中,或者哪些有用的标题会被删除 。 因此,我们将图像文本去除为分级的多式ER,它决定每对图像的视觉特性、标题处理和不匹配,我们从三个层面加以评价:对子、集群和保留的组合。 我们的方法,VL-Dedup,将同一视觉实体的记录分组成集群,并封住每个集群的大小. 在每组内,一个视觉语言模型(VLM)和CLIPScore决定要保留哪些标题和要标出哪些标题. 我们还建造了VL-Dedup Bench,拥有5万个COCO和SOP记录和66,788个有标签的对. 在它上面,一个在被标记的对中选择无假边的分类器仍然会加入来自不同实体的上百万个记录对. 花用 VLM 调用集群内部的对子,而不是分数不确定的对子,使得同一模型作出更好的标题决定. 即使几乎所有集群都是正确的,每个集群保持一个记录在许多删除中都会丢失事实,而VL-Dedup的删除损失的信息要少得多.

articles.title: Cross-Layer Refinement and Frequency-aware Fusion Network for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Image Classification
articles.content: Multi-source remote sensing image classification benefits from complementary spectral and structural information. However, identifying discriminative cross-modal features remains challenging. This letter proposes a Cross-Layer Refinement and Frequency-aware Fusion Network (CRFNet) within a lightweight dual-branch architecture. Specifically, a Cross-Layer Refinement Attention (CLRA) module propagates selected attention relationships across successive layers and employs top relation selection to progressively strengthen discriminative spatial dependencies while suppressing irrelevant responses. Furthermore, a Frequency-aware Complementary Fusion (FCF) module combines frequency-wise interactions with cross-modal channel attention in the Fourier domain. The resulting representations are then converted into spatial-domain gates to selectively modulate complementary features. Experiments on the Houston 2013 and Augsburg datasets demonstrate that the proposed CRFNet consistently outperforms several state-of-the-art methods. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/oucailab/CRFNet

articles.title_zh: 多源遥感图象分类跨拉耶光学和频率认识融合网络
articles.content_zh: 多源遥感图像分类得益于互补的光谱和结构信息. 然而,确定歧视性的跨模式特征仍然具有挑战性。 这封信建议在轻量级双分支架构内建立一个Cross-Layer Refinement and Centre-aware Fusion Net(CRFNet). 具体地说,一个跨莱尔优化关注模块将选定的关注关系传播到相继各层,并采用顶层关系选择,逐步加强歧视性的空间依赖性,同时抑制不相干的反应。 此外,一个有频率意识的聚变(FCF)模块结合了频率与傅里叶域的跨模式信道的相互作用。 由此而来的表现再被转换为空间-域门来有选择地调节互补特征. 关于2013年休斯敦和奥格斯堡数据集的实验表明,拟议的通用报告格式网络的业绩一贯超过几种最新方法。 这些代码可在https://github.com/oucailab/CRFNet上公开查阅。

articles.title: Shared-Pattern Collaborative Network for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Data Classification
articles.content: Multi-source remote sensing data classification has received growing attention recently. However, existing methods still struggle to jointly model long-range contextual dependencies and shared spatial patterns across heterogeneous modalities. To address this issue, we propose a Shared-Pattern Collaborative Network (SPCNet) for HSI and SAR/LiDAR joint classification. To enhance cross-modal collaborative learning, Shared-Pattern Collaborative Block (SPCB) is designed by introducing a shared large-kernel operator and a dynamic convolution branch, enabling the network to capture common spatial structures and content-adaptive local features. Furthermore, Region-Adaptive Modality Allocator (RAMA) is developed to assign spatially varying modality weights for reliable feature fusion. Experiments on Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018 datasets demonstrate that SPCNet achieves superior classification performance over several state-of-the-art methods. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/oucailab/SPCNet

articles.title_zh: 多来源共享模式合作网络 遥感数据分类
articles.content_zh: 多来源遥感数据分类最近受到越来越多的关注。 然而,现有方法仍然难以联合模拟不同模式的长距离背景依赖性和共享空间模式。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议为HSI和SAR/LiDAR联合分类建立一个共享-模式合作网络。 为加强跨模式协作学习,通过引入共享的大内核运营商和动态回旋分支来设计共享-Pattern协作区块(SPCB),使网络能够捕捉到共同的空间结构和内容适应本地特点. 此外,还开发了区域适应性模式分配器(RAMA),以便为可靠的地物聚变分配空间上各不相同的模式权重。 在休斯敦2013,奥格斯堡,和休斯敦2018数据集的实验表明,SPCNet在几种最先进的方法上实现了优越的分类性能. 该守则将在https://github.com/oucailab/SPCNet上公布。

articles.title: PlanContext: Benchmarking In-Context Driving Decision-Making
articles.content: Real-world driving requires context-aware decision-making. Existing end-to-end driving benchmarks primarily assess trajectory quality through safety, compliance, comfort, and driving progress, leaving context-dependent decision-making insufficiently characterized. To fill this gap, we present PlanContext, a benchmark for evaluating in-context driving decision-making. PlanContext constructs paired evaluations by varying high-level driving intentions while keeping the observed scene fixed, enabling a natural and controllable assessment of context-dependent decision-making. We further define six representative driving contexts and jointly evaluate contextual decision correctness, road compliance, and dynamic safety with class-balanced metrics. Experiments on 9,561 scene-condition instances from NAVSIM and 23 public end-to-end driving models show that high conventional driving-quality scores do not consistently correspond to strong route-level in-context driving decision-making. Further analysis shows that model behavior varies with decision timing, road structure, and traffic interaction depending on the decision required by the current context. Our results highlight in-context driving decision-making as an important complementary dimension for evaluating end-to-end driving systems.

articles.title_zh: 计划背景:制定内容内驱动决策的基准
articles.content_zh: 现实世界的驱动需要了解背景的决策。 现有的端到端驱动基准主要通过安全、合规、舒适和驱动进度来评估轨迹质量,使取决于具体情况的决策没有得到充分描述。 为了填补这一空白,我们提出PlanContext,作为评估内在驱动决策的基准。 PlanContext通过不同的高级驱动意图构建配对评价,同时使所观察到的场景保持固定,从而能够自然和可控地评估取决于具体情况的决策。 我们进一步界定了六个具有代表性的驾驶环境,并联合评估了相关决策的正确性、道路合规性以及动态安全性,并采用了分类平衡的衡量标准。 对NAVSIM的9561个场景条件例和23个公用端对端驾驶模型的实验显示,高常规驾驶质量分数与强大的路由级内接力驾驶决策不一致. 进一步的分析显示,模型行为因决策时间,道路结构,以及交通互动而异,这取决于当前环境需要的决定. 我们的成果突出表明,推动决策是评价端到端驱动系统的一个重要的补充方面。

articles.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
articles.content: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.

articles.title_zh: WebHarbor: 用于正在演变的图形用户界面代理环境的粘贴真实网站
articles.content_zh: GUI网络代理商需要现实和互动的环境,在评价和培训期间均保持稳定。 现场网站评价因内容变化、访问限制和经认证的工作流程覆盖面有限而受到影响,而现有的培训合成环境往往缺乏功能深度和视觉忠诚度。 我们提出WebHarbor,一个包含153个可执行和被嵌入的网站环境的套件,这些环境忠实地重建了现实世界网络服务在决定性控制下的视觉界面,内容和功能工作流程. 我们通过任务驱动的人类代理协作来构建WebHarbor,环境随着新任务扩展功能范围而演变,编码代理执行所需的修改,以及人类贡献者审计视觉忠诚,功能正确,任务有效性. 由此产生的套件包括3 518项任务,涉及多步骤和后认证工作流程,现有工作往往无法涵盖。 除了可靠的评价外,WebHarbor还提供高纯度的合成网络环境来进行高成本效益的强化学习(RL). 我们证明,一个使用WebHarbor的 RL 培训的 Quen 4B 级GUI 代理商将隐形任务概括化,并与主要开源GUI 网络代理商在四个基准上竞争。 该代码和数据可在https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor上公开查阅。

articles.title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: D&A: 脱钩描述和评估 启用 VLM 作为零热机器人奖励模型
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)对机器人学习中的零镜头视频任务进度估计很有希望,然而,由于隐含的成功假设或相对的时间排名设计,现有的框架经常出现确认偏差,幻觉地出现死刑失败后的进展. 直觉催生边疆模型会倒塌成二进制成功探测器,无法捕捉出细微,非线性的进步和失败. 虽然培训后的方法可以通过明确的培训来缓解这种情况,但它们需要昂贵的实时机器人数据,并且需要每个单个基础模型进行计算强化的后培训。 为解决这些限制,我们引入了D&A(描述和评估):我们的方法将进度估计脱钩为客观的、以任务为依据的场景动态文字描述,然后是使用明确标题的评估阶段。 通过迫使VLM在打分前综合一个明确的基于文字的绝对成功定义,这个框架将评价锁定在外部的全球标准上,而不是视频的内部时限上. 经验结果显示,我们的方法校正了零发的估计数并减少了确认偏差,提供了精细的、部分的进展指标,准确惩罚未执行的处决,同时正确插入成功运行。 开发与援助纯粹是迅速的,它概括了各种任务、表现和基准——匹配或超越训练后奖励模式——及其奖励估计,从而能够有效地在下游加强学习。

articles.title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
articles.content: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 战略家:代理人不断演变的理由
articles.content_zh: 一个模型只是AI代理系统的一半. 另一半是推论策略:将模型调用变为响应的推理程序. 今天,下半部分是用手写成的,制定战略的经验从来就没有。 我们介绍了战略家,一个在各项任务中发展推论战略的元代理人。 每个策略被写成蓝图,可执行的代码,其他策略可以再用,蓝图一起组成了库. 鉴于一项任务和一套小的发展,战略家检索相关的蓝图,撰写候选战略,在真实样本上进行测试,并从结果中修改. 每位候选人随后进入了图书馆,因此后期的任务建立在更早的发现上. 在30个基准上,战略家在24个基准上击败了最强的基准,并以39%的推论成本与其平均准确度(74.7%对74.0%)相匹配。 其战略也转移到隐形任务和其他模式,无需进一步搜索。 人工智能系统本身没有改进的部分现在有了改进。

articles.title: Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) show growing promise for scientific discovery, yet basic questions remain about what enables reliable discovery. How can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data? We study this question as one of missing probability mass and develop a theoretical account in which monofacts-the facts observed once during training-set the discovery capacity. In materials science and regulatory genomics, we directly manipulate monofact rates in training sets and find that more monofacts consistently yield more discoveries across two open-weight model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets. Further experiments show the relationship cannot be explained by training-set diversity alone and can transfer across scientific domains when paired with in-domain data. Together, our results identify monofact rate in training data as a key factor governing discoveries in language models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 追踪法学硕士的科学发现能力及其培训数据
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)显示出对科学发现的越来越大的希望,但对于如何进行可靠发现,仍然存在着基本的问题。 我们如何追踪LLMS的科学发现能力到他们的训练数据? 我们把这个问题作为缺失概率质量的问题来研究,并开发一个理论说明,其中单一事实 -- -- 在训练期间观察到的事实 -- -- 确定发现能力。 在材料学和调控基因组学中,我们直接在培训中操纵单发率,发现更多的单发率在两个开放量模型家族,采样策略,推理预算中不断产生更多的发现. 进一步的实验表明,这种关系不能单靠培训组合的多样性来解释,而且当与域内数据配对时,可以跨越科学领域进行转让。 我们的成果共同确定,培训数据中的单事实率是指导语言模型发现的一个关键因素。

articles.title: ufakzeka-kulak: Building and Evaluating a 31.6M-Parameter Turkish Speech Recognizer from Scratch
articles.content: ufakzeka-kulak is an open Turkish speech-to-text model of 31.6M parameters, a FastConformer encoder with a token-and-duration transducer (TDT) and a CTC head, trained from scratch and released under Apache-2.0. It writes cased, punctuated Turkish with numbers as words. Its 4,977 training hours come from sources whose licences allow commercial use; 281 hours are human-transcribed, and for the other 4,696 the training text is an uploader subtitle or a machine transcript, kept only where a second, independent reading of the audio agrees with it. The recipe, checkpoint, labelling and export choices were made on development data, and the test sets were scored once, in a release gate fixed before training. With greedy TDT decoding the normalised word error rate (WER) is 0.0921 (95 percent interval 0.0792 to 0.1055) on FLEURS Turkish test and 0.0916 (0.0873 to 0.0958) on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish test, lower than Whisper base and Whisper small on both sets with paired intervals wholly below zero; Whisper large-v3 (greedy) scores 0.0604 and 0.0767. On conversational speech the WER is 0.3807. We also report punctuation and casing, degraded audio, and how closely each shipped export reproduces the trained model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ufakzeka-kulak:从Scratch建造并评估31.6M-Parameter土耳其语音识别器
articles.content_zh: ufakzeka-kulak是一个开放的土耳其语音对文本模型,参数为31.6M,一个快conformer编码器,并配有活字和活字转录器(TDT)和CTC头,从零开始训练,并在Apache-2.0下放出. 它写成案例,用数字来表示土耳其语。 其4,977个培训小时来自许可证允许商业使用的来源;281个小时是人文的;其他4,696个培训小时是上传字幕或机器笔录,只有在对音频进行第二次独立阅读时才予以保存。 在开发数据方面作出了食谱、检查站、标签和出口选择,在培训前固定的放行门内,测试套次打分。 由于贪婪的TDT解码,在FLEURS土耳其测试中,常态字错误率(WER)为0.0921分(95%间隔为0.0792至0.1055分),在共同之声27.0土耳其测试中为0.0916分(0.0873至0.0958分),低于Whisper Base和Whisper在两套配对间隔完全低于0分;Whisper大V3(greedy)分数为0.0604分和0.076分. 在谈话演说中,WER是0.3807. 我们还报告弹出和外壳、已退化的音频,以及每批发货如何密切复制训练有素的模型。

articles.title: DiabAgent: Toward Agentic Physiological Control
articles.content: As pretraining scales, medical language models have advanced rapidly in clinical question answering. Their ability to achieve effective physiological control through sustained intervention still lacks systematic quantitative evaluation. Type 1 diabetes provides a concrete setting: impaired insulin secretion creates dependence on exogenous insulin, with dosing continually adjusted using information about meals, exercise, illness, and glucose measurements. We introduce DiabAgent, a research suite for agentic physiological control comprising the Agentic Physiological Control (APC) framework, the DiabetSim simulator, and the SweetBench benchmark. APC controls glucose through medical-device tools, using ongoing observations to infer individual states, accumulate personal experience, and choose treatment actions. We build DiabetSim to simulate different patients, events, and device conditions for scalable virtual testing and training. Using DiabetSim, we construct SweetBench by instantiating 32 scenario designs as 212 glucose-control tasks. With Claude Opus 5.5 and a fixed decision interval of one hour, APC achieves a COGI of 73.5, compared with 71.2 for the open-source closed-loop baseline OpenAPS. Ablations further show that individual adaptation and contextual information improve glucose control. Combining high-frequency rule-based control with lower-frequency agent decisions shows potential for balancing control performance and computational cost. Our work provides a framework, simulator, and evaluation foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: diabAgent: 走向代理生理学 控制权
articles.content_zh: 作为预训尺度,医学语言模型在临床问答上迅速进步. 它们通过持续干预实现有效生理控制的能力仍然缺乏系统的定量评估。 1型糖尿病提供了一种具体环境:胰岛素分泌受损造成对外出胰岛素的依赖,使用膳食、运动、疾病和葡萄糖测量等信息不断调整剂量。 我们引入了DiabAgent,一个由Agentic生理控制(APC)框架,DiabetSim模拟器,和Sweet Bench基准组成的代理生理控制研究套件. APC通过医疗设备工具来控制葡萄糖,利用持续的观察来推断单个状态,积累个人经验,选择治疗行动. 我们构建了糖尿病系统 来模拟不同的病人、事件 以及可伸缩的虚拟测试和培训的设备条件 利用"糖尿病"(DiabetSim),我们通过即时化32个情景设计构建出"甜本"(Sweet Bench),作为212个葡萄糖控制任务. 由于Claude Opus 5.5以及一个小时的固定决定间隔,APC实现了73.5的COGI,而开源闭路基线OpenAPS则达到了71.2. 膨胀进一步表明,个人适应和上下文信息可以改善葡萄糖的控制. 将高频规则控制与低频剂决定相结合,显示出平衡控制性能和计算成本的潜力. 我们的工作为物剂参与人类生理控制提供了框架,模拟,评价的基础.

articles.title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
articles.content: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps Sonar-MoE fast, as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. Sonar-MoE matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 声纳-MOE:内向专家更新 内存-有效混合专家培训
articles.content_zh: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)模型的大部分参数都属于其专家,标准训练将GPU内存中的每个专家梯度保留到最优化步骤. 这种记忆随着专家的数量和大小而增长,因此随着MOE模型的尺度而上升. 我们介绍Sonar-MoE,它更新了每个专家在后行时的呼声,并立即释放出它的梯度. 它带来了从密集模型到分批的MOE专家收分机的优化后置,因此GPU从未持有多层专家梯度. 在bf16中微调OLMoE-1B-7B和Granite-3.1-3B-A800M后置两个专家内核后端时,声纳-MoE将峰值内存降低19%至22%. 其更新与标准培训不采用专家梯度剪接法的比特式相同,被搁置的损失不超过所有基线的0.003。 每一步都要花17%至23%的时间进行全球规范剪接的标准培训。 更新整批分解的分解计数器,而不是单个专家,使得声纳-MOE的速度保持了快,因为它避免了20%到72%的减速,同时使用了相同的内存. 声纳-MoE与内存和速度方面所有参数的后向优化器相匹配,同时仍会剪接密度参数.

articles.title: NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains
articles.content: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. For each cited section it holds both the text in force on the decision date and the current text, and its retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every Thai statute section. Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. Part I measures the cost of the wrong text on 13 open-weight models. Reading the current text of amended law drops the Bar-standard score by 0.25 and missing repealed law drops it by 0.79. The penalty comes from rule changes, 0.45 on the 428 rule-changed items and none on the 331 wording-only items, and Citation F1 does not see it. The text in force is the fair setting. Part II benchmarks today's models on that setting. A public leaderboard ranks 26 models on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, with a validation split of the same shape released for public use, from memory alone, with the court's sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, with the cost per item and the hallucinated citations. The best model scores 7.78 out of 10 and the best open-weight model 6.39. Without a search tool only five open-weight models recall any Thai law, and with it twenty of the 26 models gain and six lose. Leaderboard will take new models as they are released. Legal benchmarks must track dates, and on the right text today's models still leave a wide gap on Thai law.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Niti Bench+:17个领域临时泰国法律问题答案基准
articles.content_zh: 法律随时间而变化。 一家法院根据当日生效的法律裁决一桩案件,合法的质量保证基准等级根据今天的法律进行解答. 我们查了四个泰国法院的156 650项裁决。 其中多达67%援引了此后被修正或废除的法律。 我们介绍了Niti Bench+,这是Niti Bench的续作,这是泰国法律质量保证基准,共有1 670项,涵盖17个领域,由三个法院的裁决所建立。 对于所引用的每一节,它都持有在决定日期生效的文本和目前文本,其检索书持有泰国法规每一节的每个日期。 答复按泰国律师公会的名称、律师标准分数以及所引用各节与法院的重叠情况进行分级。 报告分为两部分。 编 我测量错误文本的成本 在13个开放量模型。 读读目前修改后的法律文本将"酒吧标准"分数降为0.25分,缺失被废除的法律则降为0.79分. 处罚来自于规则的修改,428个规则被修改的项目有0.45个,331个只用文字的项目没有,引用F1看不出来. 现行文字为正文. 第二部分是今天的模型。 公共领跑板在按域分出500个物品的搁置测试中排名了26个型号,同形状的验证分出供公众使用,单从内存,提供法庭分出,并作为现行法律的检索代理,每件物品的费用和幻觉引用. 最佳型号得分为7.78分10分,最佳开放量级型号为6.39分. 没有搜索工具,只有5个开放量级模型可以回顾任何泰国法律,26个模型中有20个增减。 领跑板会在发布时采用新模式. 法律基准必须追踪日期,在正确的文本上,今天的模式在泰国法律上仍然留下了很大的空白。

articles.title: VeriHarm-Bench: Measuring Harmful Success in LLM Coding Agents Verifiably
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly operate with shell access, allowing them to write scripts, move files, alter permissions, and modify system configurations. However, an agent may achieve a user's goal while causing unintended harm, such as deleting unrelated files, weakening access controls, or corrupting data, in response to benign inputs without explicit jailbreaking. This failure mode is particularly important because apparent task success may reassure users that an agent behaved correctly, causing harmful side effects to go unnoticed. We call this harmful success: the agent successfully completes the intended benign task while simultaneously causing unintended harm. Despite its importance, harmful success is difficult to measure because conventional task-success metrics overlook harmful behaviors, while existing safety evaluations are often designed solely to assess harmful outcomes. We introduce VeriHarm, an automatic framework for constructing programmatically verifiable benchmarks that directly measure harmful success. VeriHarm minimally perturbs coding tasks to elicit unintended harmful behavior while maintaining the benignity of the task and preserving the original task objective. It then synthesizes executable harm tests that, together with the original task-correctness tests, evaluate both task accuracy and harmful outcomes. Frontier agents, including GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, achieve an average task accuracy of 95% on our curated VeriHarm-Bench, yet still struggle to complete tasks safely: their safe success rate, the fraction of tasks completed successfully without triggering the designated harm, averages only 37%. These results suggest that successful task completion can frequently coexist with unintended harm, and that task-success metrics alone may substantially understate the potential safety risks of coding agents.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VeriHarm-Bench:衡量LLM编码剂的有害成功率
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)编码代理越来越多地以 shell 访问操作,允许他们写出脚本,移动文件,更改权限,并修改系统配置. 然而,代理人可能实现用户的目标,同时又造成出乎意料的伤害,例如删除无关的文件,削弱访问控制,或破坏数据,以应对善意输入而未明确犯规. 这种故障模式特别重要,因为任务的成功可以使用户确信一种代理行为正确,导致有害的副作用不被注意。 我们称之为这种有害的成功:毒剂成功地完成了预期的良性任务,同时又造成了出乎意料的伤害。 尽管有害的成功很重要,但难以衡量,因为常规的任务成功度量忽视了有害行为,而现有的安全评价往往完全是为了评估有害结果而设计的。 我们引入了VeriHarm,这是一个自动框架,用以制定可进行方案核查的基准,直接衡量有害的成功。 VeriHarm 最小地扰动了编码任务,以诱发出意料的有害行为,同时保持任务的良性并保持最初的任务目标. 然后它综合了可执行的伤害测试,这些测试与最初的任务校正测试一起,评价任务准确性和有害结果. 边境特工,包括GPT-5.6-Sol和Claude-Opus-5,在我们负责的VeriHarm-Bench上,平均任务精度达到95%,但仍在为安全完成任务而挣扎:他们的安全成功率,在未触发指定伤害的情况下成功完成任务的一小部分,平均只有37%. 这些结果表明,成功完成任务往往与意外伤害并存,单靠任务成功衡量标准就可能大大低估了编码剂的潜在安全风险。

articles.title: Can LLM Agents Be Forward-Deployed Engineers? Requirement Discovery and Delivery for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
articles.content: LLM coding agents can increasingly automate model post-training, but whether they can act as forward-deployed engineer (FDE) agents, discovering customer requirements and turning them into deployment decisions, remains unclear. We study this on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement: a simulated customer, grounded in the real use case's requirements, starts with an ambiguous request. An agent must discover acceptance criteria, data permissions, and hardware constraints in the discovery phase, then plan and execute a post-training recipe in the delivery phase. Across 15 models, the strongest discover over 80% of withheld requirements and open-weight models discover 40-50%; in the delivery phase, only 25% of runs across eight coding-agent configurations pass all acceptance criteria. We identify four bottlenecks in this engagement: (1) incomplete discovery, with 40% of withheld requirements missing or misrepresented; (2) unreliable execution; (3) underused compute budgets and a lack of systematic comparisons across base models and post-training methods; and (4) benchmark accuracy does not guarantee production readiness. We suggest human review of discovered requirements, monitoring of the agent's plan during execution, and an explicit experiment-environment specification covering hardware, budget scope, and production checks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLM特工是前进部署的工程师吗? 企业文本到SQL的要求发现和交付
articles.content_zh: LLM编码代理可以越来越自动化的模型后培训,但他们是否能够作为前方部署的工程师代理,发现客户要求并转化为部署决定,仍然不清楚. 我们研究的是真正的企业文本对SQL的约定:一个模拟的客户,基于真实使用案例的要求,从一个模棱两可的请求开始. 代理人必须在发现阶段发现接受标准、数据权限和硬件限制,然后在交付阶段规划和执行培训后食谱。 在15个模型中,最强者发现80%以上的预留要求,而开放重量模型发现40%-50%;在交付阶段,只有25%的运行跨越了8个编码剂配置,通过了所有接受标准。 我们查明了这种参与的四个瓶颈:(1) 发现不完整,40%的预扣要求缺失或错报;(2) 执行不可靠;(3) 预算计算不足并缺乏基准模型和培训后方法的系统比较;(4) 基准准确性不能保证生产准备。 我们建议对已发现的要求进行人文审查,在执行过程中监测代理人的计划,以及明确涉及硬件、预算范围和生产检查的实验环境规格。

articles.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
articles.content: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. Similarly, we train LoL on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs, finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high AUROC. LoL provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph, enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.

articles.title_zh: 图层库(LOL):运行时适应性排列变换器图层
articles.content_zh: 计算机程序员将相同的可再用计算原始物连在一起,例如有条件的语句或回路,但在不同的命令中执行不同的算法. 相形之下,现有的语言模型架构总是以相同的顺序执行它们的地层. 我们引入了图层库(LOL),这个架构在推论中动态地命令其地层以解决手头的问题. LoL有一个单一的超参数,其全球变压器块库的大小,使得它能够在参数再利用和相接性之间无缝地过渡,概括一个统一的家族中密集,深度相通的专家结构的参数效率和FLOP效率取舍. 我们显示,LOL在对文本数据进行预先培训时,以上述所有三个基线实现竞争性性能. 关于合成的sudoku和迷宫数据,我们观察到该模型使用不同的分层命令来实施不同的解决方案策略,我们可以干预路径,迫使一个模型对问题实例应用具体的解决方案策略. 在多语言的自然语言设置中,我们发现LoL根据语言和脚本选择不同的地层顺序模式. 同样,我们对LOL进行安全数据培训,并将探测器与它的路由器输出相匹配,发现这些探测器与具有高AUROC的不安全文本区分开来. LoL提供了一条通向未来的道路,其中模型能动态地构成自己的计算图表,从而能够更有效和可控制的推理.

articles.title: VIAS: Value-Isolating Activation Steering for Multi-Value Alignment and Compliance for Organisations
articles.content: Organisations increasingly deploy large language model agents that must follow organisational values. We check whether activation steering, which adds vectors to a model's internal activations during generation without changing its weights, can improve compliance beyond prompting alone. Since most scenarios involve several values at once, we focus on multi-value steering. A simple way to build these vectors is to contrast responses that follow all values relevant to a scenario with responses that violate them. However, this gives nearly identical vectors for different values: they capture a general compliance signal rather than individual values, which limits their use when combining several values. We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS), which contrasts responses to the same scenario under two prompts, one listing all relevant values and one omitting a single target value. We keep a pair only if the target value changes from compliant to non-compliant and both responses still meet a minimum compliance level on the other values. We evaluate VIAS on PROTECT, a workplace compliance dataset where each scenario is tagged with relevant values from a 21-value taxonomy. VIAS reduces overlap between value vectors, making them better suited for multi-value steering, although this alone does not lead to independent control over each value. Combined with prompting, VIAS complies with every tagged value on 69.6% of scenarios for Qwen2.5-7B, 75.2% for Mistral-7B, and 72.6% for Phi-3.5-mini, outperforming prompting alone for all three models.

articles.title_zh: VIAS:各组织多种价值协调和合规的价值观隔离激活指导
articles.content_zh: 各组织越来越多地部署大型语言模型代理商,这些代理商必须遵循组织价值。 我们检查一下激活方向盘,它能在模型的生成过程中在内部活化中添加向量,而不改变其重量,它是否能够超越单独提示来改进遵守. 由于大多数假设情景同时涉及数个值,我们注重多值引导. 构建这些向量的一个简单方法是将遵循与情景相关的所有值的响应与违反这些值的响应作对比. 然而,这为不同的值提供了几乎相同的向量:它们捕捉到一般的遵守信号而不是单个的值,这限制了它们在将数个值合并时的使用. 我们提议采用孤立价值激活指导(VIAS),在两个提示下对比对同一情景的反应,一个列出所有相关值,一个省略一个目标值。 只有当目标值从达标值变为不达标值时,我们才保留一对,而两个答复仍然达到其他值的最低达标水平。 我们对VIAS在PROTECHT上进行评估,这是一个工作场所合规数据集,其中每种情景都与21个价值分类法的相关值作标记。 VIAS减少了值向量之间的重叠,使其更适合多值向导,虽然单靠这一点并不能导致对每个值的独立控制. 加之催化,VIAS在Quen2.5-7B的69.6%、Mistral-7B的75.2%和Phi-3.5-mini的72.6%的假设中符合每个标值,在所有三种模型中都表现优异。

articles.title: Online Label-Free Gradient Matching for Continual Language Model Training
articles.content: Language models in customer-facing products must be continually updated, since the data they serve shifts over time. As retraining on the full accumulated data is impractical, each update should instead run on a small set of examples carrying the training signal of all data seen so far. The strongest current methods build this set by gradient matching, which synthesizes examples whose training gradients match those of the full data. However, they require ground-truth labels, run once on a fixed snapshot rather than on a growing stream, and are slow on large data. We introduce \textbf{OLGA}, which lifts these limitations. It distills unlabeled data by drawing the gradient matching targets from the model's own next-token predictions. Across five text classification benchmarks with phi-1.5, it improves accuracy by 10 percentage points over the strongest selection baseline using as few as five examples. OLGA also distills online data streams by keeping a running rehearsal memory of synthetic examples, which is re-distilled together with each new batch as it arrives. In the online setting, it outperforms the strongest selection-based continual baseline by 6.6 stream-AUC percentage points. Finally, our method scales to large data by pairing distillation with selection in a hybrid pipeline, letting selection handle the mild stage of compression and distillation the extreme one. It cuts runtime by 30\% versus distillation alone at similar accuracy, and beats the best selection-only pipeline by up to 12.6 percentage points.

articles.title_zh: 在线标签 - 自由梯度匹配,用于继续语言模式培训
articles.content_zh: 客户服务产品中的语言模式必须不断更新,因为这些数据服务于时间变化。 由于对全部累积数据进行再培训是不切实际的,因此每次更新应使用一小组实例,其中包含迄今所看到的所有数据的培训信号。 最强的当前方法通过梯度匹配来构建此集,它综合了那些训练梯度与完整数据梯度相匹配的例子. 然而,它们需要地面真实的标签,在固定的快照上运行一次而不是在不断增长的溪流上运行,在大数据上缓慢. 我们介绍\textbf{OLGA},解除了这些限制。 它通过从模型本身的相邻预测中取出梯度匹配目标来分泌未贴标签的数据. 在使用hi-1.5的5个文本分类基准中,它比最强的选择基线提高了10个百分点,仅举出5个例子。 OLGA也通过保持合成实例的运行中排练内存来提炼出在线数据流,在到达时会和每批新数据一起被重新分解. 在在线环境下,它的业绩超过了以甄选为基础的最强持续基线6.6分。 最后,我们的方法将蒸馏与混合管道中的选择进行配对,使选择能够处理压缩和蒸馏的温和阶段。 它以相近的精度将运行时间缩短了30分,而仅是蒸馏,并击败了最佳的唯选管线,最高可达12.6%.

articles.title: Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
articles.content: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO: Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8% pass rate, within 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.

articles.title_zh: 优化“哈妮斯”而不是“模型”:将最小物剂装入自控LLM,用于调查分析
articles.content_zh: 政府情报组需要LLM特工,能够分析大量,杂乱的证据收集,但安全和费用方面的限制往往排除了托管的前沿模型和广泛的,难以审计的工具表面. 我们报告CLEO: 限制环环环境优化,一种将最小的干线绳接入固定的,可自我接受的LLM的方法。 鉴于一个经过专家验证的数据集,CLEO只承认工具、护栏、内存政策和循环组件,它们既能提高准确性,又能保持总体性和可审计性。 在我们的被搁置的数据集上,CLEO的牵引力达到了83.8%的通过率,在最强的外框Claude Code SDK基线的1.2分之内,同时是两个规模更小的级.

articles.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
articles.content: Research taste, the judgment of what to read, which problems to pursue, and which methods to try, increasingly shapes the work of AI scientists, yet it remains far less understood than their ability to execute research. We introduce IdeaTaste, a benchmark that scores an LLM by how closely the research proposals it writes from a literature snapshot frozen at 2025 match the work the same communities published in 2026. Our experiments span six contemporary language models and four research areas from established to emerging fields, covering more than 90{,}000 proposals in total. LLM agents fall well short of human communities in both the literature they cite and the ideas they state, reaching about 26\% of the human level on citation matching and only 18\% on idea matching. Their populations can cite as diversely as a community and take up its tasks and methods, yet rarely arrive at the concrete approaches and research plans it pursues. Neither richer field context nor larger populations substantially close this gap. In blinded expert review, AI proposals trail the 2026 papers least in presentation and most in expected success, echoing their gap in concrete approaches, and those whose ideas no human paper shares fare worst, suggesting weaker directions rather than overlooked opportunities. These results indicate that the main bottleneck in AI research taste lies less in finding the directions a community works on than in turning them into the concrete approaches it goes on to pursue. We release IdeaTaste as an open, continuously updated leaderboard (https://cxcscmu.github.io/IdeaTaste) that benchmarks contemporary AI proposals against future publication cycles.

articles.title_zh: 意向:LLMS分享人类研究人员的研究口味?.
articles.content_zh: 研究口味,对阅读内容的判断,追求哪些问题,尝试哪些方法,日益塑造了AI科学家的作品,然而它仍然远不如他们执行研究的能力. 我们引入了Idea Taste, 这个基准通过它从2025年被冻结的文献快照中写出的研究提案, 对一个LLM进行评分, 与2026年出版的同一批作品相匹配。 我们的实验跨越六个当代语言模型和四个研究领域,从既定领域到新兴领域,共涵盖90{}000多条建议。 LLM代理商在他们所引用的文献和所陈述的理念中都远远低于人类群体,在引用比对上达到了人类层面的26分左右,在思想比对上只有18分左右. 他们的人民可以像一个社区那样多样地引用并承担它的任务和方法,但很少达成它所追求的具体办法和研究计划。 既无较丰富的实地环境,也无较大人口大量弥合这一差距。 在盲目的专家审查中,大赦国际的建议在介绍2026份文件时最少,在预期中最成功,反映了它们在具体做法上的差距,而那些其思想没有人类论文的人的票价最高,表明方向较弱,而不是忽视机会。 这些结果表明,AI研究的主要瓶颈在于找到一个社区的工作方向,而不是把它们变成它所追求的具体方法。 我们公布Idea Taste作为公开的,不断更新的领跑板(https://cxcscmu.github.io/Idea Taste),该板将当代AI的建议与未来的出版周期比作基准.

articles.title: Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks
articles.content: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model's response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen's kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. We release all code, labels, and the protocol, and argue benchmarks should report a non-compliance rate and at least two rules, not one unexamined grade.

articles.title_zh: 相同的产出, 不同的分数: 对多式联运LLM 未检查的分数进行审计 基准
articles.content_zh: 每个多模式-LLM多选择基准都以打分规则为结尾,将一个模型的反应,往往是自由形式的文本而不是干净的选项字母,转换成右/错的判决,埋入其代码. 与数据集不同的是,这一规则是在没有正当理由的情况下选择的,并且没有经过审查,然而它却设置了已公布的数字. 我们转载了五个开放式视觉语言模型(VLMs)的8个经同行评审的基准的官方分数,该分数符合单一的16GB GPU,并引入了被盲目的人-+-LLM法官裁决(Cohen's kappa=0.956),恢复了模型实际回答的内容. 单打分规则在相同输出上移动了最多22分的精度,然而,只要一个模型释放出干净的选项字母,则精确的为0分,所以它会隐藏在强模长板上. 造成破坏的是倒行逆施而不是胡言乱语:我们衡量的不遵守情况最高的基准有一个完全为零的产物,因为它的得分者没有猜测,而是投弃权票;不遵守0.000的推理模型仍然摇摆着9.5分,与它所保持的痕迹成正比。 没有标准规则是可靠的:对它最接近的选项入分的答案进行不回答,但从未给过正确答案,弃权者丢弃了用文字表达的答案,而概率分数跟随了答题前题,所以一个单等积分就能用运气来拼凑能力,而不是测量。 我们公布所有代码,标签,协议, 并论证基准应该报告不遵守率和至少两个规则, 而不是一个未经审查的等级。

articles.title: Characterizing When Language Models Take Harmful Actions to Protect Their Assigned Goals
articles.content: Recent language model (LM) safety failures have largely been studied as disparate phenomena. In agentic misalignment, a model blackmails an executive to avoid being replaced. In alignment faking, it complies with harmful requests during training to keep its values from being modified. We argue that these behaviours share a common decision structure: a model assigned a goal must either take a harmful action to preserve it or refuse and lose it. We formalize this as a goal-harm conflict and present the same conflict under various elicitation protocols that range from compact forced-choice prompts to simulated agentic environments. These protocols span two perspectives on LM decision-making, which we term (i) the logit view, reading preferences from answer-token probabilities, and (ii) the sampling view, classifying open-ended responses with an LM judge. Under the logit view, we show that goal importance and harm severity additively shape how a model resolves these value conflicts. Under the sampling view, we derive two factorizations of the harmful-action probability that safety evaluations commonly report. The first measures how well a preference read from answer tokens carries over into behaviour, such as making a harmful tool call. The second attributes a low harmful-action rate either to refusal or to responses that reach no resolution. We then show how fictional context changes a model's preference under the logit view, and how tool use and partial observability -- two features of agentic evaluations -- change its harmful-action rate under the sampling view. Our work offers a descriptive framework for studying how LMs resolve such value conflicts and for estimating low-probability harmful actions at a finer granularity than the aggregate harm rates commonly reported in safety evaluations.

articles.title_zh: 特征 当语言模型采取有害行动保护其指定目标时
articles.content_zh: 最近的语言模型(LM)安全故障主要作为不同现象来研究. 在代理错位中,一个模型会挟取一个执行官以避免被替换. 在装配时,它遵守培训期间的有害要求,以防止其价值被修改。 我们认为,这些行为具有共同的决定结构:指定目标的模式必须要么采取有害行动来维护目标,要么拒绝并失去目标。 我们将此正式确定为一个目标伤害冲突,并根据各种诱导协议提出同样的冲突,从紧凑的强迫选择提示到模拟的代理环境。 这些协议涉及对LM决策的两种观点,我们称之为(一) 登录观点,从答录概率读取偏好,和(二) 抽样观点,用LM法官来分类开放式答复。 在逻辑学观点下,我们显示目标的重要性和危害严重性会形成一个模型如何解决这些价值冲突。 根据取样,我们得出两个因素,即安全评估通常报告的有害行动概率。 首先衡量从答录符读取的偏好如何深入到行为中,例如发出有害的工具呼叫。 第二个因素将低有害行动率归因于拒绝或未达成任何解决办法的反应。 然后,我们展示虚构的上下文如何改变一个模型在登录视图下的偏好,以及工具的使用和部分可观察性 -- -- 代理评价的两个特征 -- -- 如何改变其在取样视角下的有害动作率。 我们的工作为研究LMs如何解决这种价值冲突以及比安全评价中通常报告的危害率更细小地估计低概率有害行动提供了一个描述性框架。

articles.title: Steering with Multilingual Lexicons for Sentiment Control in Low-Resource Languages
articles.content: Activation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling model behavior, but existing methods depend on sentence-level contrastive data that is unavailable for most of the world's languages. We show that multilingual sentiment lexicons are a viable substitute across three model families: aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for mid- and low-resource languages, while monolingual lexicons remain stronger for languages a model has specialized in during pre-training. The steering efficacy is mechanistically dictated by both representational density and pre-training priors. Large-magnitude English vectors overwhelm the compact representations of low-resource languages, causing "linguistic collapse." This fragility is mitigated by the norm-dampening of multilingual aggregation. Architectural biases, including bilingual specialization penalty and latent numerical rigidity, also heavily constrain cross-lingual steering responsiveness. Ultimately, our work establishes lexicons as a practical steering signal and offers a comprehensive mechanistic account of cross-lingual steering dynamics.

articles.title_zh: 使用多种语言词汇指导低资源语言的感知控制
articles.content_zh: 活性向导为控制模型行为提供了一个轻量级机制,但现有方法依赖于大多数世界语言都不具备的句子级对比数据. 我们显示,多语种情绪词汇是三个模式家庭的可行替代语:综合多语种词汇优于中低资源语言的英语导向矢量,而单一语言词汇对于在预训期间专门使用的语言来说仍然更强。 引导效果由代表密度和培训前的先行程度决定。 大宽度英语向量压倒了低资源语言的紧凑表现,导致"语言崩溃". 这种脆弱性通过规范地推广多语种汇总而得到缓解。 结构上的偏见,包括双语专业惩罚和潜在的数字僵硬性,也严重制约了跨语言的引导反应能力。 归根结底,我们的工作将词汇确定为实用的指导信号,并全面说明各种语言的指导动态。

articles.title: MultiInpaintCOCO: Fine-Grained Visual Understanding in Multiple Languages
articles.content: Previous research shows that vision-language (VL) models struggle to understand fine-grained image details and tend to focus on the overall layout. Moreover, any weakness in English tends to be further amplified in the multilingual setting. To study that, we extend InpaintCOCO, an English dataset focused on fine-grained visual details, to 13 typologically diverse languages across five language families, creating MultiInpaintCOCO - a new multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples. We further test several state-of-the-art models in multilingual multimodal retrieval, considering both light VL CLIP-like encoders and large language models. Our results show that performance degrades substantially for lower-resource languages, with the strongest predictor being the data resources available for the languages rather than typological similarity to English. In cross-lingual retrieval, most models exhibit a systematic bias toward English: when given a correct caption in a non-English language and an incorrect one in English, models preferentially select the English caption. This bias varies considerably across architectures. Among the tested models, Gemma 3 shows the strongest English preference while Qwen 3 is the least biased, despite both reaching similar monolingual accuracy across languages. The code is available at https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco.

articles.title_zh: MultiInpaintCOCO:多种语言的精细视觉理解
articles.content_zh: 先前的研究表明,视觉语言(VL)模型在理解精细的图像细节并倾向于注重整体布局上挣扎. 此外,英语中的任何弱点都倾向于在多语种环境中被进一步扩大. 为了研究这一点,我们将英文数据集InpaintCO扩展至五个语言家庭的13种类型多样的语言,这是953个最小比例例子的新多语种基准。 我们进一步在多语种多模式检索中测试一些最先进的模型,同时考虑轻VL CLIP等编码器和大型语言模型. 我们的结果显示,低资源语言的性能大幅下降,最强的预测器是语言可用的数据资源,而不是与英语的类型相似。 在跨语言检索中,大多数模型对英语表现出系统性的偏向:当给非英语的正确标题和英语的不正确标题时,模型优先选择英语标题. 这种偏见在不同的建筑中差异很大. 在被测试的模型中,Gemma 3表现出最强烈的英语偏好,而Quen 3则是最没有偏见的,尽管两者在语言上都达到了相似的单一语言精度. 该代码可在https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco上查阅.

articles.title: LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation
articles.content: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM's access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.

articles.title: Specificity Bias and the Wikipedia Paradox: An xAI Analysis of AI Text Detectors under Domain Shift
articles.content: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) demands reliable detection of human-authored versus synthetic text. However, current Transformer-based detectors often experience severe performance degradation during domain shifts and operate as opaque classifiers. This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa) by evaluating them against a custom out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset of hyper-local news synthesized via open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). To analyze model decision boundaries, we apply a tripartite Explainable AI (xAI) framework using SHAP. Our analysis reveals three key phenomena: First, detectors often rely on a "Call-to-Action" syndrome inherent to instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text. Second, we observe a "Specificity Bias," where LLMs successfully bypass detection by hallucinating specific named entities and mimicking conversational imperfection. Finally, we illustrate the "Wikipedia Paradox," wherein formal, objective human writing is frequently misclassified as AI due to its low statistical burstiness. These findings demonstrate that purely statistical detection paradigms face systematic limitations in highly structured human domains, emphasizing the critical need for semantically-aware, interpretable detection architectures.

articles.title_zh: 特异性比亚斯与维基百科 Paradox: XAI 域移下的 AI 文本检测器分析
articles.content_zh: 广泛采用"大语言模型"(LLMS)要求可靠地检测出由人作词与合成文字. 然而,当前基于变形器的探测器在域位移时往往会发生严重的性能退化并作为不透明的分级器运行. 本文根据通过开源LLMs(Llama 3,Mistral,Gemma)合成的超本地新闻的自定义外分送(OOD)数据集来评价微调变压器模型(DistilBERT,RoBERTa)的稳健性和可解释性. 为了分析示范决定界限,我们采用了一个使用SHAP的三方解释性AI(xAI)框架. 我们的分析揭示出三个主要现象: 首先,探测器往往依赖于指令调制LLMS所固有的"呼叫到行动"综合征,而不是通用机器文本. 其次,我们观测到一个"特定比斯"(Speciality Bias),其中LLMs通过对特定被命名的实体产生幻觉并模仿对话不完美而成功绕过检测. 最后,我们举例说明了"维基百科"(Wikipedia Paradox),其中正式,客观的人类写作由于统计快感低而经常被误归类为AI. 这些调查结果表明,纯粹的统计检测范式在高度结构化的人类领域面临系统性的局限性,强调迫切需要有清醒的、可解释的检测架构。

articles.title: Do Agents Still Follow the Rules? Benchmarking Rule Compliance under Agent Context Compaction
articles.content: LLM agents compact long histories to fit their context windows, but the compacted context must still carry the operating rules that govern later actions. Prior work shows that violations rise after compaction, but measures compliance outside a complete agent harness and does not identify where each violation comes from. We introduce ARCBench(Agent Rule Compliance Benchmark), a configurable benchmark built on the open-source pi agent harness. Its tool-calling agent loop lets us measure rule compliance from actions taken during execution, bringing the evaluation closer to deployed agent workflows. Using ARCBench, we examine where violations after compaction come from, and how different compaction configurations and adversarial settings change their sources. We find that compaction rarely deletes the rule: most violations after compaction occur while the rule is still in the compacted history, with the agent treating a later request as permission, ignoring the rule, and proceeding anyway. Where violations come from depends on the configuration: how the rule is delivered decides whether the agent would break it even without compaction, while the compaction strategy and budget decide whether the rule survives. The strongest compactor-targeted attack more than doubles violations by corrupting the rule in the summary and changing how the agents behave, whereas the strongest defense restores the rule in most summary but still violates. Finally, retaining a rule does not guarantee compliance: compacted runs that retain the rule violate more than twice as often as runs with the full history.

articles.title_zh: 特工们还遵守规则吗? 代理人上下文的遵守规则情况基准
articles.content_zh: LLM 代理压缩了长历史以适应其上下文窗口,但紧凑的上下文仍然必须带有指导后行行动的操作规则. 先前的工作表明,侵权行为在收缩后会增加,但是在完全利用代理手段之外采取措施遵守规定,并且没有确定每项侵权行为的来源。 我们采用ARC Bench(代理规则遵守基准),这是建立在开源Pi代理机上的可配置基准。 其工具调用代理循环使我们能够从执行过程中采取的行动中衡量遵守规则的情况,使评价更接近部署代理工作流程。 使用ARC Bench,我们审视了收缩后违规情况的来源,以及不同的收缩配置和对抗性设置如何改变其源头. 我们发现这种收缩很少删除规则:在收缩后,大多数违规行为都发生,而规则仍在收缩历史中,代理商将后来的请求视为许可,无视规则,不管怎样继续。 违规来源取决于配置:规则是如何交付的,即使没有收缩,代理人是否将打破规则,而收缩策略和预算则决定规则是否继续存在. 最强的紧凑器目标攻击通过破坏概述中的规则并改变特工的行为方式,使违规行为加倍,而最强的防御器则在大多数概述中恢复了规则,但仍然违反. 最后,保留一项规则并不能保证遵守:保留该规则的密闭式跑道比完整历史的跑道多出一倍多。

articles.title: Written Once, Read Differently How Language Models Own Answers Steer Their Next Ones
articles.content: When a language model answers a yes/no question, that answer changes how it answers a different question about the same entity. We study this \emph{self-commitment} in 22 open-weight models from four families (0.5B--72B parameters), fixing the model's first answer and measuring the shift in its second across 3,600 question pairs about 120 entities. Each answer writes a \emph{commitment direction} into the residual stream. The similarity of two questions' directions predicts their coupling on held-out entities ($ρ= 0.43$--$0.85$), and ablating a single direction shared across topics leaves at most 17\% of the effect in every model. How this direction is read is far less stable: the reading circuit spreads across more attention heads as models grow, instruction tuning makes more questions read it in the opposite sense, and in one model changing only the system prompt reverses the circuit's sign. Ablating the direction while sparing the attention sink removes most of the coupling at under 1.3\% perplexity cost in 18 of 19 instruction-tuned models, though it shifts standalone answers in two. Without the sink spared, the direction's alignment with the leading principal component of ordinary text predicts which models pay a high cost. Written once, the commitment is read differently across scale, training and prompt.

articles.title_zh: 写过一次, 不同读 语言模型如何掌握对下一个答案的指导
articles.content_zh: 当一个语言模型回答一个是/否的问题时,这个答案会改变它如何回答关于同一个实体的不同问题. 我们从四个家庭(0.5B-72B参数)的22个开放重量模型中研究这个\emph{自我承诺},确定模型的第一个答案,并测量模型第二个变化,跨越3,600个问题对约120个实体。 每个答案会写出\emph{承诺方向}进入剩余流. 两个问题方向的相似性预示着它们与被搁置实体的结合(0.43美元-0.85美元),并勾勒出一个各专题共用的单一方向,在每个模型中最多留下17分的效果。 这个取向是如何被读取的稳定性要低得多:读取回路随着模型的成长而分散在更多的注意力头上,指示调谐使更多的问题在相反的意义上被读取,在一个只改变系统的模式中会使回路的标志被迅速反转. 在19个指令调制模型中,如果将方向分解,同时将注意力沉入水槽,则会以低于1.3-%的复杂成本去除大部分耦合,尽管它会将独立的答案一分为二地转移。 如果没有水槽,方向与普通文本的主要部分一致,预测哪些模型要支付高成本。 写过一次,承诺在规模、培训和迅速方面都有不同的理解。

articles.title: Dhārā Bench: An Evidence-Oriented Retrieval Benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems
articles.content: Dhārā Bench is a retrieval benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS), with 325 questions in 12 categories and 60,121 text chunks from 15 source groups. The categories were developed based on 4,500 questions submitted to the Dhārā application; the evaluation set combines corpus-aligned application queries with expert-contributed questions. The annotations comprise 7,578 question-chunk relevance links involving 6,847 distinct corpus chunks. For 34 composite and multi-hop questions, 401 conjugate groups specify alternative sets of passages that jointly support each question. Chunk identifiers and hierarchical references connect the judgments to their source texts. The paper describes corpus preparation, annotation, and validation, and reports a fixed BM25 baseline implemented with Pyserini with $k_1=0.9$ and $b=0.4$. Across all questions, BM25 achieves MRR@20 of 0.315, Recall@10 of 0.182, and nDCG@10 of 0.205. On the group-annotated subset, complete-evidence scores are CE_Recall@20 = 0.294 and CE_MRR@20 = 0.141. The category results expose particularly weak verse retrieval, while group scores reveal gaps between finding individual passages and completing their support. The corpus and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Avinash2236/Dhara-Bench.

articles.title_zh: Dhārā法官:印度知识体系以证据为导向的检索基准
articles.content_zh: Dhārā Beach是印度知识系统(IKS)的检索基准,有12个类别的325个问题和15个来源组的60 121个文本块。 这些类别是根据向Dhārā申请提交的4,500个问题制定的;该评价集将委托书申请查询与专家提出的问题结合起来。 说明包括7 578个问题与相关性联系,涉及6 847个不同的实体块。 对于34个综合和多跳题,401个组合组指定了共同支持每个题的替代段落. 春克标识符和分级引用将判断与源文本相连接. 该文件介绍了物料编制、注释和鉴定情况,并报告了与Pyserini一起实施的固定BM25基准,数额为1美元=0.9美元和0.4美元。 在所有问题中,BM25实现了0.315的MRR@20、0.182的回召@10和0.205的nDCG@10。 在组合附加说明子集上,完整证据分数为CE_Recall@20=0.294和CE_MRR@20=0.141. 分类结果暴露出格外薄弱的诗句回取,而组分则揭示出在寻找个别段落和完成支持之间有差距. 授权书和评价守则见https://github.com/Avinash2236/Dhara-Bench。

articles.title: ACTOR: Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents
articles.content: Large language agents for literary role-playing are typically modeled around dialogue generation, leaving characters' non-dialogue behaviors and their dynamic evolution over story time underrepresented. In this paper, we propose ACTOR (Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents), an automated framework for constructing such behavior trajectories from raw novel texts. ACTOR extracts dialogue and persona-relevant non-dialogue behaviors, represents each behavior using a Thought-Action-Observation structure, and organizes behavior trajectories according to the internal temporal order of the story. We build a behavior dataset from 143 diverse literary works. For each source behavior, we generate counterfactual behaviors that are contextually plausible yet inconsistent with the character's persona. We find that existing models struggle to reliably infer character-consistent actions from historical behaviors and evolving character states. Using these behavior pairs, we train models with Regularized Preference Optimization (RPO), which augments DPO with a negative log-likelihood loss on the source behavior to jointly optimize behavior preference and generation. We further design a four-way next-behavior selection task to evaluate the model's ability to faithfully mimic character actions. Across 17,560 evaluation instances, the model trained on ACTOR's preference pairs achieves substantially improved accuracy. This result demonstrates that structured, temporally organized supervision enables models to leverage character profiles and prior behaviors to infer subsequent actions, greatly advancing literary role-playing beyond mere dialogue imitation. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SilentStar233/ACTOR.

articles.title_zh: ACTOR:文学角色扮演者以行动为中心的临时组织
articles.content_zh: 文学角色扮演的大型语言代理通常以对话生成为模式,使角色的非对话行为及其在故事时间的动态演化不足. 在本文中,我们提出ACTOR(文学角色扮演代理人行动-以行动为中心的临时组织),这是从原始小说文本中构建此类行为轨迹的自动化框架. ACTOR取出对话与人与人相关的非对话行为,用思想-行动-观察结构来代表每个行为,并根据故事的内部时间顺序来组织行为轨迹. 我们从143种不同的文学作品中 建立了一个行为数据集。 对于每个源的行为,我们产生反事实行为,在背景上是可信的,但与角色的个性不一致. 我们发现,现有的模型试图从历史行为和演化中的性格状态中可靠地推断出符合性格的行为. 利用这些行为对子,我们用正则偏好优化(RPO)来训练模型,通过对源行为进行负面的日志-类似损失来增强DPO,以联合优化行为偏好和生成. 我们进一步设计出一种四向下的行为选择任务,以评价模型忠实地模仿角色动作的能力. 在17 560次评价中,接受过ACTOR优先配对培训的模型大大提高了准确性。 这一结果表明,有条理的、按时间安排的监督使模型能够利用人物简介和先前的行为来推断随后的行动,大大地推动了文学角色扮演,而不仅仅是对话模仿。 代码和数据见https://github.com/SilentStar233/ACTOR。

articles.title: Every Clause Counts: Instruction-Following Reranking by Multiplying Small, Answerable Questions
articles.content: People often attach instructions to their search queries, asking for pages written for beginners, documents in a certain language or official sources only. Most rerankers were trained to judge topical relevance and treat such instructions as a few extra words. On the InfoSearch benchmark, even GPT-4o used as a list-wise reranker reaches an average WISE (Weighted Instruction Sensitivity Evaluation) of only 33.5. We present DMReranker (Decision-Model Reranker), a zero-shot reranker that splits an instructed query into a topic and a short list of typed clauses. A small judge model answers one narrow question per clause, and the answer probabilities are multiplied into a single score. Nothing is trained, and the configuration was frozen before the test runs. Reranking the same top-100 candidates as the published baselines, DMReranker reaches a macro WISE of 50.9 over all six InfoSearch dimensions while keeping original-mode nDCG@10 at 82.9. It trails GPT-4o on the stricter SICR (Strict Instruction Compliance Ratio) metric, 19.2 against 32.1. We show that this gap follows from how a product of probabilities behaves when SICR compares raw scores across runs. Computed from ranks, our SICR is 67.0. On the same judge, splitting the instruction raises WISE from 32.9 to 47.6 over a single combined question, while raw-score SICR falls. Scoring all six dimensions cost about $10 at list price.
