articles.title_zh: 每个条款计数: 指令- 由多功能小问题重新排序
articles.content_zh: 人们常常在搜索查询中附加指示,要求为初学者撰写网页,只使用某种语言或官方来源的文件. 大多数重新排名者都接受了判断专题相关性的培训,并将此类指示作为几个额外的词来对待. 在InfoSearch基准上,即使是作为列表重排器使用的GPT-4o也只达到33.5的WISE(加权指令敏感性评价)平均值. 我们介绍 DMRanker(决定-模式Ranker),一个零发重排,将一个指示的查询分为一个话题和一个打出的条款的短列表. 一个小法官模型每个条款回答一个狭义的问题,答案概率被乘以一分. 没有经过训练,配置在测试运行前被冻结. DMReranker将与公布的基线相同的前100名候选人重新排序,在所有6个信息搜索维度上达到50.9的宏WISE,同时将原始模式nDCG@10保持在82.9. 它跟踪了GPT-4o更严格的SICR(Strict Teach understanding rate)度量衡,19.2比32.1. 我们显示,这一差距源于一种概率产物在SICR对比生分横跑时的表现. 从队伍计算,我们的SICR是67.0. 在同一名法官身上,将教学分开,将WISE从32.9提高到47.6,放在一个综合问题上,而原始分数SICR则下降。 6个维度都按列表价格计算成本约10美元.

articles.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
articles.content: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. Through a shared application layer, humans and agents inspect and revise the same evolving documents, presentations, CAD models, and Blender scenes, so human-in-the-loop participation can enter both through conversation and through direct modification of the work itself. To sustain continuity across agents and sessions, CoworkOS further introduces hierarchical workspaces and persistent semantic memory, so working files, key decisions, and long-running Job logs remain shareable, reusable, and resumable after interruption. Across 12 benchmarks and 6 categories of real-world applications, CoworkOS proves highly competitive with frontier agent applications such as Codex and DeepSeek Harness. As a sustained-work case study, CoworkOS uses GLM-5.3 as its backbone to conduct RSI-driven automated post-training on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Over five rounds, the model's average score across eight benchmarks rose from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76). Looking ahead, we believe CoworkOS opens a meaningful path toward general cowork-agent intelligence.

articles.title_zh: CoworkOS:真实世界自动化的缩放代理同事
articles.content_zh: 合作代理商的快速进步正在将人与AI的合作转向现实世界的自动化,交付软件,设计等文物. 然而,这种生产力工作既需要高质量地完成复杂的生产力任务,也需要长期持续地监测和决策,这仍然是一项公开的挑战。 我们引入了CoworkOS,一种用于长视野工作的通用工具,它把任务战略与执行管理区分开来:模型决定行动,授权和接受,而运行时间则保持状态和反馈. 其三层结构使得能够以稳定的责任,同步或同步地直接执行或授权给子代理人。 通过一个共享的应用层,人类和代理人检查并修改了相同的演化文件,演示,CAD模型和Blender场景,因此人入会参与可以通过对话以及直接修改作品本身进入. 为了保持代理和会话之间的连续性,CowoOS进一步引入了分级的工作空间和持久的语义内存,因此工作文件,关键决定,以及长期运行的工作日志仍然可以共享,可再使用,中断后可以恢复. 在12个基准和6个类别的现实世界应用中,CoworkOS被证明与诸如Codex和DeepSeek Harness等前沿代理应用具有高度的竞争力. 作为持续工作的案例研究,CoworkOS使用GLM-5.3作为骨干,在Qune3.6-35B-A3B上进行RSI驱动的自动化后培训. 在5轮以上,该模型在8个基准中的平均分从33.19分上升到42.95分(+9.76分). 展望未来,我们相信CoworkOS打开了一条通往一般合作代理情报的有意义的道路.

articles.title: ViAdminShift: A Vietnamese Benchmark for Event-Level Knowledge Updates Built from the 2025 Administrative Reform
articles.content: On July 1, 2025, Vietnam reduced its 63 provinces to 34, abolished its 696 districts, and replaced its 10,035 commune-level units (wards) with 3,321. ViAdminShift, a Vietnamese language resource about this event, consists of 7,995 benchmark items, 2,281 retrieval passages from pre- and post-reform Wikipedia revisions and dated templates, and old-to-new tables that a released script rebuilds from the official conversion table (not redistributed). Changed items store the pre-reform answer (except 121 address items), a $2\times2$ design uses untouched units as controls, and 400 addresses appear without diacritics. The tables agree with an independent lineage on 10,564 of 10,565 official pairs, disagreements were settled against the resolutions, and the probing-track scorer agrees with both authors' blind labels (Cohen's $κ=0.91$ and $0.89$). Data, outputs, code, and a datasheet are released. In the probing track, at least 20 of 67 models know the reform. Fourteen of them give the new province alone for at most 11% of plain questions about old addresses (old province only: 14-100%); a bare date recovers up to 100%. Post hoc (80 province-free addresses, single runs), with reasoning off, today's date in the system prompt leaves 68-100% old-province-only answers for 10 of 12 models; with reasoning, an "as of" prefix in the question leaves none for seven of eight. On the 1,262-item benchmark subset, with same-source old and new passages, small models unaware of the reform give 14-30% outdated answers and the five benchmark-track knowers (also differing in size or provider) 0-5%.

articles.title_zh: ViAdminShift:2025年行政改革后建立的越南事件层面知识更新基准
articles.content_zh: 2025年7月1日,越南将63个省减至34个,撤销696个县,以3,321个乡级单位(下同)取代了10,035个乡级单位(下同). ViAdminShift是越南有关此事件的一款语言资源,由7,995个基准项目,2,281个从改革前和改革后维基百科修订稿和日期模板中取出段落,以及一个发布的脚本从官方转换表重建的旧到新表格(没有重新分配)组成. 被更改的项目存储了改革前的答案(除了121个地址项目),一个2\times2$的设计使用未触动的单元作为控制器,400个地址出现时没有二极管. 表格与10 564个10 565个正式配对的独立分行一致,解决了与决议的分歧,而探测轨道计分员同意两位作者的盲标(Cohen's $-0.91美元和0.89美元)。 发布数据,输出,代码和数据表. 在探测道上,67个模型中至少有20个知道改革. 其中14个只回答有关旧址的11%的简单问题(只回答14-100%);裸枣恢复了100%。 后临时(80个省免地址,单行),有推理的,今天的系统日期催促为12个模型中的10个给出68-100%的旧省只答;有推理的,问题中的"截至"前缀没有为8个中的7个给出一个. 关于1,262项基准子集,有同源新旧段落,不了解改革的小模型给出了14%-30%的过时答案,五个基准轨道知识者(大小或提供者也不同)给出了0-5%的答案.

articles.title: DepthGraft: Structural Regularization through Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction
articles.content: Scaling depth is a key route to stronger large language models, but Pre-LN architectures often suffer from depth-wise information dilution, limiting the effective use of deep layers. While cross-layer connectivity has proven effective at mitigating this problem, existing designs usually introduce additional computation or memory access. We revisit cross-layer KV sharing as an efficient form of such connectivity. Beyond cache compression, each KV reuse edge creates a direct gradient path from deep layers to source KV projections, turning KV sharing into an implicit structural regularizer for KV representation geometry. We provide a systematic analysis of this mechanism, showing that proper sharing topologies sharpen key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace, whereas existing adjacent or global-anchor designs do not fully exploit this effect. Motivated by this, we propose DepthGraft, a hierarchical KV-sharing architecture that reconstructs deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow-middle source pairs. DepthGraft distributes non-local gradient flow across source layers, while preserving prefill early completion and reducing KV cache by roughly one third. Experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B parameters show consistent downstream improvements under both GQA and MLA. Notably, on the 16B MoE model, DepthGraft achieves a 7.0% absolute improvement on MMLU-Pro, along with gains of 6.6% on CMMLU and 6.4% on C3. These results validate the potential of DepthGraft as a scalable design for large-scale pretraining. The project page is available at https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft.

articles.title_zh: 深度外观:通过分级跨拉耶克V进行结构规范化 重建
articles.content_zh: 放大深度是更强大的大语言模型的关键途径,但前LN架构往往会受深度信息稀释的影响,限制了深层的有效利用. 虽然跨层连通性已被证明能有效缓解这个问题,但现有的设计通常会引入额外的计算或内存访问. 我们重新审视跨层KV共享作为这种连接的有效形式. 除了缓存压缩外,每个KV再利用边缘都会产生从深层到源KV预测的直接梯度路径,将KV共享转化为KV表达几何的隐含结构常态. 我们对这一机制进行了系统分析,表明适当的共享地形会突出关键检索方向,同时丰富价值内容子空间,而现有的相邻或全局锁定设计并没有充分利用这种效果。 以此为动力,我们提出"深度分流"(DepthGraft),一种分级的KV共享架构,从相通相通的浅中源对重建出深层KV. DepthGraft在源地层间分布出非局部梯度流,同时保留了预填提前完成并减少大约三分之一的KV缓存. 关于从0.5B到16B参数的密度模型和MOE模型的实验表明,在GQA和MLA下游都有一致的改进. 值得注意的是,在16B MOE模式中,深度分层在MMLU-Pro上实现了7.0%的绝对改善,同时CMMLU的增益为6.6%,C3的增益为6.4%. 这些结果验证了深度外观作为大规模预训可扩展设计的潜力. 项目网页见https://github.com/jianke0604/ DepthGraft。

articles.title: Meet Students Where They Are: Student-Prefix Teacher Adaptation for On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) mitigates the student's exposure bias by optimizing on student-generated trajectories. However, student-generated prefixes may contain reasoning errors or follow patterns unfamiliar to the teacher, undermining the reliability of its token-level supervision. This degradation becomes more pronounced as prefixes grow longer. To address this teacher-side distribution mismatch, we propose Student-Prefix Teacher Adaptation (SPTA), which adapts the teacher to the states on which it is queried during distillation. Specifically, before OPD starts, we collect student rollout prefixes with random lengths and continually train the teacher to continue from the prefixes using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). By treating each prefix as context and rewarding correct final answers, the teacher learns to recover from student-induced states rather than imitate the student's reasoning. Then, the adapted teacher is used for standard OPD, with no changes to the distillation objective. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that our SPTA improves average student performance over standard OPD and OPD with task-level RLVR-adapted teachers. These results highlight the importance of adapting teachers not only to solve problems independently, but also to provide reliable guidance on the states their students actually visit.

articles.title_zh: 满足学生的所在位置:学生-前身教师适应政策上的扭曲
articles.content_zh: 政策分解(OPD)通过优化由学生产生的轨迹来缓解学生的曝光偏好. 然而,学生产生的前缀可能包含推理错误或遵循老师不熟悉的规律,会损害其象征级监督的可靠性. 随着前缀的延长,这种退化变得更加明显. 为了解决教师-教师分配不匹配的问题,我们建议学生-教师前期适应(SPTA),使教师适应蒸馏过程中被询问的州。 具体地说,在OPD开始之前,我们收集随机长度的学生推出前缀,并持续地训练老师从前缀继续使用可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR). 通过将每个前缀作为上下文对待,并奖励正确的最终答案,老师学会从学生引起的状态中恢复,而不是模仿学生的推理. 然后,被改造的老师被用于标准OPD,蒸馏目标没有变化. 对数学推理基准的实验表明,我国的SBA比标准OPD和OPD提高了学生的平均成绩,配有任务级的RLVR适应教师. 这些结果突出表明,必须使教师不仅能够独立解决问题,而且能够为其学生实际访问的国家提供可靠的指导。

articles.title: Preprocessing Choices in Fine-Tuning Data Matter: Utility and Demographic Sensitivity in LLM-Based Recommendation
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have introduced a generative approach to recommendation, producing item lists from textual representations of user histories and item information. However, this generative setting raises challenges concerning output validity, prompt consistency, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors. In this work, we investigate how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior in a generative LLM-based recommender system. We first establish a controlled recommendation pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning, catalog-constrained decoding, and prompt augmentation. We then study three preprocessing choices: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. Experiments on MovieLens-1M show that the catalog-constrained pipeline eliminates out-of-catalog items and ensures complete ten-item outputs, while prompt augmentation improves prompt consistency and utility. Original MovieLens titles increase HR@10 from 10.67% to 12.47% and Coverage@10 from 41.36% to 47.88%. Fairness-related effects are attribute-dependent: age balancing and knowledge enrichment reduce selected group-level utility gaps while largely preserving utility, whereas gender balancing reduces utility without improving the evaluated gender-related indicators. Overall, preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data should be evaluated jointly in terms of utility, output behavior, and demographic sensitivity.

articles.title_zh: 精细调试数据物质的预处理选择:基于LLM的建议中的效用和人口敏感性
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)引入了一种对推荐的基因化方法,从用户历史和项目信息的文字表述中生成项目清单. 然而,这种基因设定在产出有效性、迅速一致性和对人口描述的敏感性方面提出了挑战。 在这项工作中,我们调查微调数据中的预处理选择如何影响一个基因LLM-基于推荐者的系统中的推荐效用和与公平相关的行为. 我们首先建立了一个控制性建议管道,将监督的微调、编目约束的解码和迅速增强结合起来。 然后,我们研究三个预处理选择:项目标题说明、人口平衡和辅助项目知识丰富。 关于电影Lens-1的实验 M显示,受目录限制的管线消除了目录外的项目,并确保完成十项产出,而即时增强则能提高及时的一致性和效用. 电影原版标题将HR@10从10.67%增加到12.47%,覆盖度从41.36%增加到47.88%。 公平性相关效应取决于属性:年龄平衡和知识的丰富缩小了某些群体层面的效用差距,同时在很大程度上保持效用,而性别均衡则减少效用,而不改进经评价的与性别有关的指标。 总体而言,在微调数据方面的预处理选择应当从效用、产出行为和人口敏感性等方面联合评价。

articles.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.

articles.title_zh: 博士像素: Page- Native 深度研究与视野-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 科学论文等复杂文件在表格,数字和等式中包含丰富的信息;然而,现有的深入研究(DR)代理人通常会将论文减少为OCR所取出的案文. 相反,我们询问,视觉语言模型(VLMs)是否可以进行页内深入研究:直接检索和推理所制作的文件页图像。 我们引入了DR Pixel,这是第一个使用已渲染的页面图像作为唯一检索和推理单元的开源端到端多模式DR代理,运行于1.06M页的集合上. 为了评估这一设置,我们构建了DRPixel Bench,这是科学论文的基准,需要从文字、数字、表格和等式上进行推理。 出人意料的是,网页原生DR在未经培训的情况下已经取得了良好效果,在GPT-5.4,双子座-3.5-Flash,Qune3.6-27B等最先进的模型上表现优于基于OCR的基线,同时需要更少的工具呼叫. 我们接下来是DR训练。 一项关键的挑战在于,教师对代理制导微调的轨迹很吵,把批评推理和行动步骤与多余或失败的尝试相混合。 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了反事实信用再加权法,这是一种精细的信用分配方法,它通过个人推理和行动步骤对最终答案的反事实贡献进行加权。 我们的培训提高了大约15分的检索率,在DRPixel Bench上提高了10分以上的最后准确度,同样也超过了四个现有基准上未经培训的基线。 关于分配外的ViDoRe-V3, DR 像素在直接给予金页的甲骨文1.8分之内. 我们的结果表明,传统的OCR-当时的检索管道不仅没有必要,而且不尽人意:直接检索和对可视文件页的推理使复杂的DR既更有效又更有效率。

articles.title: An Experimental Study of Hybrid Retrieval, NLI and Open-source LLMs for Scientific Claim Verification
articles.content: Claim verification is the task of deciding whether a source text supports a claim, contradicts it, or lacks sufficient evidence. Natural Language Inference (NLI) models can judge whether a single sentence supports or contradicts a claim, but they struggle when the evidence is spread across several sentences. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason across sentences, but may draw conclusions the text does not support. In this experimental study, we test whether a conservative fusion rule, labeling a claim Support or Contradict only when both models agree and defaulting to Not Enough Evidence otherwise, combines their strengths. We construct a benchmark of 2,035 claims from SciFact and CliniFact (858 Support, 152 Contradict, 1,025 Not Enough Evidence). We retrieve the top five most relevant sentences per claim using a hybrid of semantic and lexical (BM25) retrieval, which slightly outperforms either method alone. These retrieved sentences are then provided to every verification model. We then compare a DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli NLI baseline against Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B. Qwen3 achieves the highest Macro-F1 (0.7937), followed by Llama 3.1 (0.7204) and Mistral (0.6388), while the NLI baseline reaches only 0.3157. Contrary to our hypothesis, fusion degrades performance, dropping Macro-F1 to 0.7392, 0.6730, and 0.5991, respectively. To understand this decline, we analyze agreements, disagreements, and common error patterns between the NLI and LLM verifiers. Our error analysis shows that NLI and LLM disagreements often result in correct LLM predictions being overturned.

articles.title_zh: 科学索赔核查混合检索、NLI和开源有限责任公司实验研究
articles.content_zh: 索赔核实是决定来源文本是否支持索赔、是否与之相矛盾或是否缺乏充分证据的任务。 Natural Language Information(NLI)模型可以判断一个句子是支持还是与一个说法相矛盾,但是当证据分散在几个句子中时它们会挣扎. 反之,大语言模型(LLMS)可以跨句而行地解释,但可能会得出文本不支持的结论. 在这项实验性研究中,我们测试一个保守的聚变规则,在两种模型都同意和默认不足够证据的情况下,才标出索赔支持或矛盾,这是否结合了它们的优点。 我们从Scifact和CliniFact(858项支助,152项矛盾,1,025项证据不足)中确定了2 035项索赔的基准。 我们利用语义学和词汇学(BM25)的混合检索方法,检索每个索赔中最相关的前5个句子,这略高于任何一种方法。 然后将这些检索到的句子提供给每个核查模型。 然后,我们将DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli NLI基线与Llama 3.1 8B、Qune3 8B和Mistral 7B相比较。 Qune3实现了最高的Macro-F1 (0.7937),其次是Llama 3.1 (0.7204)和Mistral (0.6388),而NLI基线仅达到0.3157. 与我们的假设相反,聚变降解了性能,将Macro-F1分别降至0.7392,0.6730和0.5991. 为了理解这种下降,我们分析了NLI和LLM核查者之间的协议,分歧,以及常见的错误模式. 我们的错误分析表明,NLI和LLM的分歧往往导致正确的LLM预测被推翻.

articles.title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
articles.content: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.

articles.title_zh: 阿凡达情报:通过持久性个人代理人扩大人体机构
articles.content_zh: 个人AI代理越来越有能力处理跨应用程序的长视野任务,然而用户往往需要投入大量精力来明确目标,解决歧义并核实结果. 我们主张,衡量进展的尺度应当是代理人如何有效地扩大人类机构:使人民能够在较少例行监督的情况下实现其目标,同时保留对相应决定的控制。 我们主张通过在各种背景和时间上持续下放决策权,使《阿凡达情报》成为代表用户目标、价值观和制约因素的持久个人代理人的模式。 我们描述了从人力指导执行到授权范围内自主运作的成熟路线图,并采用了代理监督指数,作为对照代理方业务费用和人员监督负担评价交付价值的框架。 我们确定了三个核心研究挑战:身份持续个性化,它包含着用户对各种任务的偏好;通过再排练工程的用户定位演变;以及技术控制与问责和追索相结合的安全机制。 这些指示确定了一项研究议程,以便把可靠的决策权下放给不同任务和不同时期的个人代理人。
